He is wonderfully sociable with other dogs, big and small, and plays beautifully and politely with them. He’s also an absolute dream at the vets, calm and cooperative — everyone who meets him falls for his sweet nature.

He even has the potential to live with cats; in his previous life, he used to sleep in his dog house with a cat companion, sharing warmth and comfort.

He travels nicely in the car, walks well on the lead, and is more than ready to start discovering what family life means.

Currently, Apollo lives in boarding kennels, hoping that one day someone will finally choose him.

Apollo has so much love to give — he just needs someone who will finally give him the life he has always deserved. ?

Apollo comes neutered, fully vaccinated, microchipped, and with an EU pet passport.

He is ready to travel from Hungary as soon as his family is found.

name: Trixy
description:
Trixy is a 1.5-year-old, smaller medium crossbreed girl with a heart full of love. She was rescued from the streets alongside her mum (a Dachshund cross) and four siblings.

Three of the pups, including Trixy, are still waiting for their happy ending in a shelter in Hungary.

Trixy is a lively, playful young girl who sometimes shows a little shyness at first. But once she feels safe, her sweet, cuddly side shines through — she only needs love, patience, and kindness to truly thrive.

She adores playing with her doggie friends and gets along well with them.

She is friendly with people, including children, and enjoys her walks, trotting happily on the lead. Trixy would be happiest in a family where she isn’t left alone for long hours and is treated as a true member of the family — joining in on adventures, cuddles, and daily life.

She could easily share her home with another playful, gentle dog, or be the only pet, soaking up all the love and attention. Like all rescue dogs, she will need time, patience, and commitment from her new family to settle and blossom into the wonderful companion she is meant to be.

Trixy is currently in Hungary and can travel to the UK once her perfect family is found. She will come spayed, fully vaccinated, microchipped, and with an EU pet passport.

Adoption is subject to a home check and adoption fee. Full RBU provided.

name: Ariel
description:
Ariel is a 6-year-old small-medium sized girl with a big personality and an even bigger heart. This feisty little terrier has been waiting in the shelter for over 3 years… far longer than any dog should have to wait.

Ariel is full of character – a true terrier spirit. She’s lively, expressive and not afraid to let you know when she’s excited – it’s all part of her charm!

She is affectionate with people and loves children, happily soaking up attention and enjoying being part of the action. Ariel forms lovely bonds and will be a loyal and loving companion to her family.

With other dogs, she is friendly with most and enjoys their company, though like many terriers, she appreciates respectful introductions and a good match in energy.

After spending such a long time in the shelter, Ariel truly deserves a home where she can finally relax, feel safe, and be loved every day.

She would love a family who will embrace her fun personality, include her in their lives, and give her the attention she’s been missing for so long.

Ariel is in Hungary, ready to travel to the UK once a home has been secured for her.

name: Topi
description:
Topi is a 10-month-old medium sized cross breed boy. He is a real bundle of joy, very people-centred, affectionate and kind natured. He loves cuddles, attention, and being involved in whatever his humans are doing.

Topi is lovely friendly pup who loves to run, explore and play. He learns quickly, especially when there are treats and praise involved. His eagerness to please makes him a lovely dog to train and grow with.

He would thrive with an active family who enjoys daily walks, adventures in nature or even hiking. Topi would happily join in on family outings and would love to be part of everyday life rather than left on the sidelines.

Topi is brilliant with other dogs, and enjoys playing with them. He is very sociable and makes friends easily.

He would probably be happiest living with another friendly, playful dog, but may as well enjoy being the only dog in the home, soaking up all the attention.

Because he is still young, Topi will need time and patience to settle into a new environment and learn the routines of his new home. With kindness and guidance, he will quickly blossom into a truly wonderful companion.

He could live with older, dog-savvy children who understand how to interact respectfully with a puppy. He can also be tested with cats for the right applicant.

Topi is currently in Hungary and will travel to the UK once a home has been secured for him.

He comes fully vaccinated, microchipped, with an EU pet passport.

name: Loki
description:
Loki, a beautiful 2 year old Siberian Husky needs a new home through no fault of his own.

The owner has serious health problems and is unable to give him the care and attention he needs and deserves. He is spending more and more time in kennels which is far from ideal.

Loki is a lovely boy, he loves his toys and he has a kind nature. He is currently the only dog in the household, but he is friendly with dogs and wants to play on walks so he has the potential to live with another friendly dog.

He is also used to living with older children.

He is fully vaccinated and microchipped and up to date with flea and wormingtreatments.

Loki is in Chorley, Lancashire where he is visitable upon arrangement.

name: Lana
description:
Lana is a 3 month old chihuahua cross girl from Hungary who is expected to be smaller medium size when fully grown.

Lana has already had a difficult start in life, she was found with her mum and sister in a deprived area where her mum had been badly treated. Despite everything they have been through, Lana has chosen love over fear.

This beautiful girl is a happy, friendly puppy who loves cuddles and being close to people, she is a true lapdog. She has a slightly calmer nature than her sister, but still enjoys playing, exploring and having fun.

She is a sweet affectionate puppy who could happily live with a doggie mate or be the only dog in the home.

She is also happy around children and can live with older dog savvy kids.

We can also cat test her for the right applicant.

Lana has never known what it’s like to belong to a family of her own, but she’s ready to learn. She dreams of cuddles in bed, fun adventures, belly rubs and people to love for the rest of her life.

Lana is in Hungary and will travel to the UK once a home has been secured for her.

name: Sully
description:
Sully is a 5 year old medium size male cross breed. He looks like someone accidentally shrunk a Rottweiler in the wash. He’s handsome, compact, and has mastered the art of looking at you as if he’s contemplating the meaning of life.

Sully’s story didn’t begin so happily, he was surrendered in Hungary by a British family along with several other dogs.

They arrived frightened of people, fearful of new experiences, and clearly hadn’t been shown the love, kindness and guidance that every dog deserves.

For Sully the world was a scary place initially. But then he saw people who were kind to him, spoke gently, and gave him time. And it didn’t take long for him to realise that not all humans let you down.

Today Sully is a completely different dog, he enjoys life and likes human company, and although he still has his moments of insecurity, he is now curious and not fearful of the world around him.

He is a loyal, kind natured boy, quite placid in temperament. He isn’t a high energy dog either who would need endless adventures and entertainment all through the day, but he will happily join you on your walks and then enjoy home time sharing the sofa with you.

What he really wants though is a family who won’t give up on him.

Sully is friendly with most dogs with sensible introductions, very excitable dogs are probably not the best match for him but he could happily live with a friendly placid dog.

He is friendly around children, too, but he would probably be best suited to an adult-only home as he is not used to the noise and chaos that can come with young children.

We can cat test him for the right applicant.

He would really love to leave his shelter days behind and start a new life.

And he comes with a special bonus in that he understands English!

Sully is in Hungary and will travel to the UK once the right family is found for him.

He comes neutered, microchipped, fully vaccinated, with an EU pet passport.

name: Lucy
description:
Lucy is a 3.5 month old chihuahua cross girl who is expected to be smaller medium size when fully grown. Lucy’s had a difficult start in life, she was found with her mum and sister in a deprived area where her mum had been badly treated.

Her past could have made her fearful, but luckily it didn’t, and Lucy is full of trust and love.

This beautiful girl is a happy, friendly puppy who loves cuddles and being close to people, she is a true lapdog. She is a true puppy, full of life, loves to play and explore. She is jolly happy girl with a fun character.

Lucy is a sweet affectionate puppy, she loves dogs and could happily live with a doggie mate or be the only dog in the home.

She is also happy around children and could live with older dog savvy kids.

We can also cat test her for the right applicant.

Lucy dreams of cuddles in bed, fun adventures, belly rubs and a family to love for the rest of her life.

Lucy is in Hungary and will travel to the UK once a home has been secured for her.

name: Jenny
description:
Jenny is a 10 year old female Airedale Terrier Cross with a heartbreaking past and a heart full of hope. For seven long years, she was left chained outside without shelter or kindness, while the world looked away.

Her suffering only came to light by chance — her rescuers were returning another dog when they saw her standing there, neglected and desperate.

Jenny’s eyes lit up as if she knew this was her moment, and when her owner was asked to surrender her, he did so without hesitation.

Since that day, Jenny has been safe, but her home has been a kennel. A whole year has passed, and she is still waiting for the love she has never truly known.

Jenny is gentle and people-oriented. She loves her walks and is good on the lead, though she can be a little strong at times. She enjoys chasing a ball and, while she isn’t interested in making doggy friends, she’s content as long as her space is respected.

Jenny would be happiest as the only dog in the home so she doesn’t have to share attention or space.

She is spayed, fully vaccinated, and travels with her EU pet passport — ready to start the new chapter she so deserves.

Jenny has lost so many years, but it’s not too late for her to find happiness! All she wants now is to spend her golden years knowing comfort, kindness, and love.

Could you give her the forever home she has waited a lifetime for?

Fully vaccinated, spayed, microchipped, with an EU pet passport. Ready to travel.

name: Beigli
description:
Beigli is a 1.5 year-old medium-sized crossbreed boy with a beautiful soul. Born in an abandoned property alongside his six siblings, little Beigli’s life began in heartbreaking circumstances.

His mum was desperately trying to keep her babies alive while she herself was painfully thin and starving.

At just three weeks old, the family was rescued and brought to safety.

The puppies grew up, one by one they found their forever homes, and today only two remain: Beigli and his sister Maggie.

At just 1.5 years old, Beigli has already spent almost his entire life waiting.

He adores people, loves playing with other dogs, and has the kind, gentle nature that makes everyone fall in love with him.

All Beigli dreams of is a family to call his own. A warm bed. Daily walks. Someone to greet with a wagging tail and endless devotion.

He can live with older dog-savvy children and can be cat tested for the right applicant.

Beigli is in Hungary and is ready to travel to the UK as soon as the right family finds him.

He comes neutered, fully vaccinated, treated for parasites, with an EU pet passport.

name: Maggie
description:
Maggie is a 1 year old female Cross-Breed, expected to be medium-sized when fully grown.

She is currently in Hungary and is adorable and playful, as expected for her age.

Seven siblings were born in an abandoned property with their mum struggling to feed them when she was emaciated herself.

They were taken in by the local shelter at three weeks of age.

The whole litter was stunningly beautiful, and only two pups are still waiting for their families.

Maggie is fully vaccinated, free from parasites, and ready to travel. She comes with an EU passport.

She can live with dogs and older children. The right owner will need to agree to have her spayed once fully grown.

name: Tommy
description:
Tommy is a 1.5 year old male Cross-Breed, medium in size. He was rescued exactly a year ago from horrid circumstances, having been thrown into a yard with his sister, Suzy, at just a few weeks of age.

They lived on piles of rubbish, frequently escaping due to inadequate fencing and roaming the streets among busy traffic, constantly in danger. When rescued, they were emaciated and full of parasites.

Tommy and Suzy can be rehomed together or separately.

Tommy has grown to be a kind-natured, healthy dog who is active and playful according to his age. He is medium-sized and has a lovely happy character. He is very affectionate with people and friendly around kids, too.

Tommy is the more human-centred of the siblings. He loves giving kisses and is a lapdog by nature.

He is also playful and happy around other dogs.

Tommy would be happiest in a family where he is not left alone for extended periods and there is time for his training. We want him to be treated as a treasured member of the family and be taken on nice adventures. He will need time to settle into his new home and get used to his environment.

Tommy could happily live with another friendly and playful dog or dogs but may also be happy as the only dog and the centre of attention in the family.

As with all rescue dogs, he will need time, patience, love, and commitment from his adopting family to become a happy, well-balanced dog.

Experience with rescue dogs is preferred.

Tommy is currently in Hungary and can travel to the UK as soon as the right family is found for him.

He comes neutered, fully vaccinated, microchipped, dewormed, flea and tick treated, with an EU passport and DEFRA-approved paperwork.

Adoption is subject to a home check and adoption fee. Full RBU provided.

name: Suzy
description:
Suzy is a 1.5 year old female Cross-Breed, medium in size. She was rescued exactly a year ago from horrid circumstances, having been thrown into a yard with her brother, Tommy, at just a few weeks of age.

They lived on piles of rubbish, frequently escaping due to inadequate fencing and roaming the streets among busy traffic, constantly in danger. When rescued, they were emaciated and full of parasites.

Suzy has grown to be a kind-natured, healthy girl who is active and playful according to her age. She is medium-sized and has a lovely cheeky character. She loves people and is very friendly around kids, too.

She is also playful and happy around other dogs.

Suzy is perhaps slightly more reserved than her brother and enjoys doggie company a lot. She loves to play and run with her mates.

Suzy would be happiest in a family where she is not left alone for extended periods and there is time for her training. We want her to be treated as a treasured member of the family and be taken on nice adventures. She will need time to settle into her new home and get used to her environment.

Suzy could happily live with another friendly and playful dog or dogs but may also be happy being the only dog and the centre of attention in the family.

As with all rescue dogs, she will need time, patience, love, and commitment from her adopting family to become a happy, well-balanced dog.

Experience with rescue dogs is preferred.

Suzy is currently in Hungary and can travel to the UK as soon as the right family is found for her.

She comes spayed, fully vaccinated, microchipped, dewormed, flea and tick treated, with an EU passport and DEFRA-approved paperwork.

Adoption is subject to a home check and adoption fee. Full RBU provided.

name: Junior
description:
Junior is a 3-year-old male Dachshund Cross. He was rescued from a deprived area of Hungary in very poor condition and has since been given a second chance at life. Despite everything he has been through, he has remained a sweet and affectionate little dog.

He has been waiting patiently while other dogs around him have found homes, yet he has somehow been overlooked. This is especially sad because he is described as a lovable and funny boy who truly enjoys human company.

More than anything, he is simply longing to be part of a family of his own.

Junior walks nicely on the lead and enjoys getting out and about. He loves people and shows a gentle and friendly nature in his interactions. His kind temperament also means he is patient when around children.

When it comes to other dogs, Junior’s preference is for female dogs. He would be happiest living with a spayed female companion or as the only dog in the home where he can soak up all the attention.

This flexibility means he could suit different home setups, as long as his social preferences are respected.

He comes neutered, fully vaccinated, and microchipped, which gives his future family reassurance about his health care. He also has an EU pet passport, making his travel arrangements clear and straightforward.

A home check and adoption fee will apply, and full rescue back-up is provided for added support.

Junior is a small dog at approximately 10 kg, making him a manageable size for many households. His journey has not been easy, but his gentle nature and cheerful personality have stayed intact.

He is ready to leave his difficult past behind and finally enjoy the comfort and security of a loving home.

name: Leo
description:
Our extra special boy Leo is approximately three years old and almost certainly a Kokoni. Leo weighs just six and a half kilos and measures eight inches from shoulder to paw.

Having been found abandoned on the streets, Leo has been in our Cyprus shelter for two weeks.

Our shelter manager reports that Leo is bubbly and very sweet. Many others say he is the nicest dog of all. Leo has a gorgeous personality and oozes kindness, gentility and empathy.

His appearance is quite stunning. With puppy dog eyes and such a handsome face, he garners attention instantly and is best described as a showstopper.

With his perfect showstopper tri colour coat and amazing ears Leo is the talk of the town. Leo’s adopting family will be truly blessed.

Leo walks nicely on his lead and enjoys his time in the car. He seems to mix perfectly well with other dogs, cats and children.

name: Musa
description:
Currently in Spain, transport available to the UK.

Musa is a medium English Setter, 5 years old.

Musa is a beautiful setter, another given up by her hunter because they didnt think she was useful. Musa is somewhat shy with strangers but quickly warms up once she gets to know you and she soon becomes affectionate and very friendly.

She has a calm nature and gets along very well with other dogs she has met at the shelter. She shares her kennel with three other dogs, and they all eat and play together without any issues.

She is a very sweet girl and comes running when she is called around the shelter, although this will no doubt be different on an exciting walk!

Musa would do best in a quieter home, without young children. She can be cat tested for the right home.

name: Sam
description:
Currently in Spain, transport available to the UK.

Sam is a medium English Setter, 2 years old.

Sam is a lovely friendly setter, another surrendered by a hunter because he wasn’t wanted for hunting. He is a quite large compared to a lot of working setters we help and he’s got a lovely elegant build.

He is sociable with other dogs and is currently sharing a kennel with two other setters, and they all happily share their space and food without any problems.

He loves going out into the enclosed part of the shelter and spends his time chasing flies, butterflies or anything else that moves (a typical working setter!)

Sam is very affectionate with people and loves being close to them. He especially enjoys attention, cuddles and being fussed! He can live with older children and can be cat tested for the right home.

name: Txiru
description:
Txiru is a medium Sabueso mix, 8 years old.

Life has been tough for Txiru. He has spent over a year living in a shelter, so it’s no surprise that he finds the world a frightening place.

Despite everything he has been through, he remains a sweet, gentle boy who simply needs time, patience and understanding to discover that life can be safe and happy.

Txiru loves the company of other dogs and would benefit from being in a home with a calm, confident canine companion to help show him the way. He takes great comfort from other dogs and they give him reassurance when things feel overwhelming.

People, however, are a different story. Txiru is wary of strangers and needs plenty of time to build trust. If he feels worried or overwhelmed, his instinct is simply to run away or find somewhere to hide.

Because of this, he will need a secure home and garden, careful introductions to new situations, and adopters who understand that trust cannot be rushed and will give him time and patience.

Txiru isn’t looking for an adventurous lifestyle or a busy household. What he needs is somewhere calm and peaceful, where he can finally relax and begin to enjoy being a dog.

name: Laya
description:
Currently in Spain, transport available to the UK.

Laya is a small English Setter, 6 years old.

Laya is a lovely, smaller setter who was surrendered by a hunter after she wasn’t wanted for hunting. Despite her difficult start, she has a wonderful nature.

She is an active and energetic girl who enjoys being around other dogs. Laya currently shares her kennel with two other setters and they all happily share their space and her food.

Laya is incredibly affectionate and loves human company. Once she gets to know you, she’ll stay by your side wherever you go and she comes running when you call her around the shelter (although this will no doubt be different on an exciting walk).

She has a lovely gentle personality and Laya would make a wonderful girl for an active home. She can live with older children and can be cat tested for the right home.

name: Kira
description:
Our extra special girl Kira is approximately four years old and a very much-loved medium sized cross breed. Kira weighs fourteen kilos and measures fourteen inches from shoulder to paw.

Having been surrendered to the shelter by very distressed owners who could no longer keep Kira, she has been in our Cyprus shelter for one month.

Kira has clearly been very preloved. She is totally distressed at finding herself in a shelter without constant human companions. Our shelter manager describes Kira as very loving, affectionate and will make a great addition to any family.

Such a pretty girl with her tri colour coat and array of freckles. Kira’s eyes could hardly be more engaging and have a natural beauty.

Her ears are sublime and demeanour impeccable. The absolutely perfect adoption candidate with so much to offer. She will so love her adopters and repay them with premiums.

Kira walks nicely on her lead and enjoys her time in the car. She seems to mix perfectly well with other dogs, cats and children.

name: Mousey
description:
Our extra special boy Mousey is approximately three years old and a really small little chap and quite possibly a Kokoni. Mousey weighs four and a half kilos and measures seven inches from shoulder to paw.

Having been surrendered as no longer able to keep Mousey has been in our Cyprus shelter for two months.

Our shelter manager describes Mousey as a very happy blend of shy and bubbly. He will undoubtedly blossom in a secure and loving forever home.

Mousey is incredibly sweet and captures hearts instantly. His soft brown coat is delightful with a graduated tint of black and grey along his back.

His greatest joys include a lap, a cuddle and one to one attention. Such a dear low maintenance little boy with endearing puppy dog eyes. Quite a prize for a fortunate adopting family.

Mousey walks nicely on his lead and seems to enjoy his time in the car. He appears to mix perfectly well with other dogs, cats and children.

name: Diana
description:
Diana is a three year old female Brittany. Diana, is a gorgeous young female Brittany, with an unusual stunning chocolate coat.

Diana is a very active dog, pure energy, who loves to run and sniff everything. It seems she has not had much human contact, but she now lets herself be stroked and is starting to enjoy being cuddled.

She loves her food which will be useful for training. She is fairly obedient within the confines of the shelter, but in an exciting walk it would no doubt be different and recall work would be needed.

Diana was an urgent case, she was about to be dispatched by her hunter, so of course we offered to take her and an hour later she was at the shelter and safe.

She arrived at the shelter very nervous and is gradually calming down, partly thanks to the help of her kennel mate.

Diana would love a home with another friendly dog to help her confidence.

Diana’s date of birth is 14th April 2022.

If you are interested in giving wonderful Diana a home, she is available at Setter Brittany Pointer Rescue. Diana is in Spaian and ready to travel to her forever home.

name: Meisie
description:
Meisie is a 2 year old female Cross-Breed. She is small in size at around 9.5 kg and is currently in Croatia.

Meisie is a bit timid to start with but becomes very friendly. She loves to cuddle and adores playing and running. She is mostly house trained but has learned to walk well on a lead.

She is good with other dogs and can live with children who are over 8 years old. She can also live with cats that can tolerate a bouncy dog.

Meisie is microchipped, rabies vaccinated, has been vaccinated for infectious diseases two times, and will receive the bordetella vaccine before transport.

She is castrated, Mediterranean diseases tested-negative, brucellosis tested negative, and received kennel cough nasal vaccine before travel.

Adoption fee and home check apply, and full rescue backup is provided by Ninas Haven.

name: Honey
description:
Honey is a 2 year old female Cross-Breed. She is small in size at around 6 kg and is currently in Croatia.

Honey is a bit timid to start with but becomes very friendly. She loves to cuddle, adores playing and running, and is interested in everything.

She is mostly house trained but has learned to walk well on a lead.

She is good with other dogs and can live with children who are over 8 years old. She can also live with cats.

Honey is microchipped, rabies vaccinated, has been vaccinated for infectious diseases two times, and will receive the bordetella vaccine before transport.

She is castrated, Mediterranean diseases tested-negative, brucellosis tested negative, and received kennel cough nasal vaccine before travel.

Adoption fee and home check apply, and full rescue backup is provided by Ninas Haven.

name: Ava Storm
description:
Ava Storm is a 2 year old female Cross-Breed. She is small in size at around 6.5 kg and is currently in Croatia.

Ava Storm is a bit timid to start with but becomes very friendly. She loves to cuddle, adores playing and running, and is interested in everything. She has lots of energy (hence the name) but adores cuddles and fuss!!

She is mostly house trained but has learned to walk well on a lead.

She is good with other dogs and can live with children who are over 8 years old. She can also live with cats who can tolerate a bouncy dog.

Ava Storm is microchipped, rabies vaccinated, has been vaccinated for infectious diseases two times, and will receive the bordetella vaccine before transport.

She is castrated, Mediterranean diseases tested-negative, brucellosis tested negative, and received kennel cough nasal vaccine before travel.

Adoption fee and home check apply, and full rescue backup is provided by Ninas Haven.

name: Fagan
description:
Meet Fagan, a 7 year old male Cross-Breed who is medium to large in size and full of affection, once he feels safe.

Fagan has done well with visitors in his current home but can show reactive behaviours toward unfamiliar males, such as workmen.

However, he has also responded very well to male visitors he is comfortable with, accepting strokes and enjoying playtime with toys.

Fagan has previously lived with children but showed some discomfort, including baring his teeth. He would therefore prefer a home with children aged 12+ or an adult-only household.

Fagan is very good with other dogs and enjoys their company. He has previously lived with another dog and currently shares his foster home with multiple dogs, gaining confidence from their presence.

On rare occasions, he has had minor disputes around furniture, likely due to a busy household and slow introductions not being followed. He can therefore live with medium to larger dogs, provided introductions are slow and sensible.

Fagan has lived with cats for a short period and has always been gentle with them, showing no prey drive. He could live with cats following slow, sensible introductions.

Fagan accepts a collar, harness, and lead. He is generally good on the lead, though he can pull and be strong. He has shown some reactive behaviours on walks and will need an owner who is confident and willing to continue his training.

An active home with long walks or jogging would suit him well. He has good recall in the home, but when out on walks he can become distracted and overstimulated, so he should remain on the lead at all times.

He is largely toilet trained but has had occasional night-time accidents; his foster is working with him on this, so support and patience will be needed. Fagan has never been destructive and can currently be left alone for up to three hours without issue.

He sleeps downstairs overnight. He does not travel well in the car and prefers to be at the front if possible.

Fagan’s foster describes him as very affectionate but still nervous. He will need a very patient and dedicated home to build trust and work on his anxieties.

He is comfortable with females, but any males in the household should be confident and available for supervised introductions.

Fagan has had a rough life and deserves a chance with a compassionate, experienced owner who can support him with love, patience, and consistency.

name: Lula
description:
Lula is an eight year old female Pointer cross or mix. Lula would be a wonderful companion, she is wonderfully good natured and she would be very happy as an only dog.

Lula is quite calm and loves to rest in her bed. She is very affectionate and loving with people, quite greedy and loves to eat. When she goes out into the enclosed field, she does not like to be alone and always seeks human contact.

Lula was rescued from a kennel in Ourense in Spain. We know little about her previous life but we can tell from her behaviour that she is not used to being with other dogs and she does not want other dogs bothering her.

Lula has a stiff wrist from an historic accident, it does not seem to bother her at all and she can walk normally despite having little mobility in the joint.

We think Lula has some German Pointer in her and some other breeds too.

Lula’s date of birth is 4th December 2017.

If you are interested in giving wonderful Lula a home, she is available at Setter Brittany Pointer Rescue. Lula is currently in Spain and her bags are packed and he is ready to travel to her forever home in the UK.

name: Zeus
description:
Zeus is a 5 year old male Cross-Breed and is medium in size, standing at approximately 55 cm in height. He is located in Buxton, Derbyshire.

A new year and a brand new beautiful and active home are being sought for Zeus. If you are an active household that enjoys open spaces and long walks, then Zeus could be the perfect boy for you.

Zeus is fully vaccinated.DhppiL4 vaccination: 28/04/2025BiocanR vaccination: 07/04/2025

Blood tests:4DX: Negative on 19/05/2025Leishmania IFAT: Negative on 22/05/2025CCP, CCV, Giardia antigen: NegativePCR Brucellosis: Negative

He is neutered and up to date with flea and worm treatments.

Zeus was once found alone on the road, wandering a busy street while cars sped past him. No one knows how long he had been there, but it was clear he was exhausted and vulnerable. Despite everything, he held onto hope and never gave up.

Zeus is a loving, energetic boy with a big personality and plenty of affection to give. He loves to play, enjoys long walks, and thrives when he has space to explore. His ideal home would have a large garden or be close to open fields where he can enjoy enriching outdoor time.

He is very people-oriented and adores cuddles and attention, forming close bonds with his humans. Zeus has been great with children and gets on well with other dogs, although he may need a little time to settle initially.

He could live happily with another dog or as the only dog in the home. However, Zeus is not suitable for a home with cats.

Zeus does experience some separation anxiety and would do best with someone who is home most of the time or able to offer plenty of companionship. When left alone, he has previously chewed, although this behaviour has improved significantly with consistency.

He loves his toys, especially soft teddies, which rarely survive very long. Zeus can sometimes show resource guarding around food treats, so a patient or experienced owner who understands this behaviour would be ideal.

On walks, Zeus can pull on the lead as he loves to sniff and explore. His lead manners are improving, but he does not currently have reliable recall, so continued training will be essential.

Overall, Zeus is a sweet, affectionate boy who will make a wonderful companion for someone able to offer time, structure, and daily long walks. He needs a committed and understanding home where he can finally settle and feel secure.

Rescue support is available in the UK.Home check and application apply.

name: Noodle
description:
Noodle is a 4.5 year old male Spanish Mastin Cross. He is a friendly, playful boy who loves being close to his people and enjoys feeling part of the family.

Although he has a relaxed and slightly lazy nature, he still enjoys getting out for his walks.

Noodle’s recent adoption sadly did not work out, through no fault of his own. While he is great with dogs outside the home and enjoys playing with them, he finds sharing his indoor space with other dogs very stressful.

After professional assessment, it was agreed that Noodle would be happiest living as the only dog in the household.

Noodle is generally calm and easygoing in the home. He is fantastic on the lead and prefers to stroll along beside you rather than rush ahead. His steady pace and laid-back attitude make walks with him a pleasure.

Noodle is good with cats and has also shown himself to be reliable around chickens and livestock. This makes him well suited to a variety of home environments, including more rural settings.

He is best suited to a home with older children who can respect his space.

Noodle is a healthy boy who is vaccinated and castrated. He is currently based in Fife, Scotland, but can be adopted anywhere within the UK. Noodle truly deserves a forever home where he can relax, feel secure, and enjoy being the centre of attention.

name: Sue
description:
Sue is a medium size smooth coat whippet mix around 9 months old.

Sue is in foster and has been for around 1 month. She was found abandoned with her sister in Italy But has adjusted to a home really well and is house-trained.

She is living happily with 6 other dogs and 2 children 10 and 12 years old.

Sue is a very happy, energetic dog and would love a home with a big garden to run preferably with another dog. She would love long walks and would be very good at agility.

Very intelligent girl who loves to be with people and have another dog to play with.

Fences must be at least 6 ft as she can jump high.

name: Ala
description:
Meet Ala, a 7 year old female Cross-Breed rescued from a kill shelter in Romania in December 2022. Her date of birth is estimated, and she is now spayed and fully vaccinated.

Ala is a wonderful, gentle girl with a calm and sweet nature. She can be a little shy at first but is friendly with the people she knows and trusts.

She is good with other dogs and currently shares her kennel, although very energetic dogs can feel a little overwhelming for her. For this reason, if homed with another dog, they would need to be calm and respectful.

Ala has not yet been tested with cats or children, but this can be done if required.

She would love a home with a secure garden and patient, loving adopters who can give her the time she needs to settle and feel safe. Ala would thrive in a peaceful environment where she can enjoy companionship, gentle walks, and a quiet, comfortable life.

This lovely girl has been through so much and truly deserves a warm, loving home to call her own.

A home check and adoption donation apply. Full rescue backup and support are provided throughout the adoption process and for the lifetime of the dog.

name: Jolene
description:
Jolene is a 2 year old female Cross-Breed. She is a playful and affectionate dog with a bright personality and a loving nature. Her friendly attitude makes her enjoyable to be around in both home and outdoor settings.

Jolene enjoys playtime and interaction and shows a strong bond with people. She is not completely house trained yet, but she mostly toilets outside and is expected to learn fully with routine and consistency. Her willingness to learn suggests she will settle quickly into home life.

Jolene has learned to walk well on a lead and behaves very well when off lead. This shows she is responsive and adaptable when given guidance. Her confidence outdoors makes her suitable for families who enjoy walks and activities.

She is great with other dogs and can comfortably live in a multi-dog household. Jolene is suitable to live with children aged over 8 years old, provided interactions are respectful. She can live with cats, although she may become excited around them.

Jolene is a medium-sized dog weighing approximately 12kg. She is currently located in Croatia and is available for adoption to approved homes. Although she is outside the UK, full rescue procedures are followed.

Jolene is microchipped, rabies vaccinated, and has received two rounds of infectious disease vaccinations. She is castrated and has tested negative for Mediterranean diseases, including brucellosis. Bordetella and kennel cough nasal vaccinations are given before travel.

An adoption fee of £475 applies, along with a home check. Full rescue backup is provided by Nina’s Haven to support Jolene and her adopters after rehoming.

name: Grey
description:
Grey is a 5 year old male Cross-Breed. He is a calm and gentle dog with a naturally affectionate nature and a strong love for cuddles. While he enjoys playtime, he prefers it to be relaxed and not too rough.

Grey has a balanced temperament and is happy to quietly entertain himself if things become overwhelming. He is house trained and understands how to behave calmly in a home environment. His easygoing personality makes him pleasant to live with on a daily basis.

Grey gets along well with other dogs and can comfortably share his space with them. He is suitable to live with children aged over 8 years old, provided they respect his boundaries. He has not yet been tested with cats, although this can be arranged if requested.

Grey is a medium-large sized dog, weighing approximately 18.6kg. He is currently located in Croatia and is awaiting a suitable home. Despite being outside the UK, all standard adoption procedures still apply.

Grey is fully prepared for adoption, as he is microchipped, rabies vaccinated, and has received two rounds of infectious disease vaccinations.

He is also castrated and has tested negative for Mediterranean diseases, including brucellosis. Kennel cough nasal vaccination is administered prior to travel.

An adoption fee of £475 applies, along with a home check. Full rescue backup is provided by Nina’s Haven to ensure ongoing support after adoption.

name: Bear
description:
Bear is a 2 year old male Croatian Shepherd Cross. He is a friendly, people-loving dog who thrives on attention and is not shy about asking for affection.

His playful personality makes him a joy to be around, especially for adopters who enjoy an interactive companion.

Bear enjoys being petted and happily soaks up all the love he can get. He has a lively but manageable energy level and enjoys playtime as part of his daily routine. His affectionate nature means he bonds well with those around him.

Bear is not fully house trained yet, but he is expected to learn quickly in a home environment. With consistency and routine, he should adapt well to household life. His willingness to please will make training a positive experience.

Bear is good with other dogs and can happily live in a home with canine companions. He is also suitable to live with children aged over 8 years old, provided interactions are calm and respectful. He is suitable to live with cats.

Bear is a medium-sized dog, weighing approximately 10kg. He is currently located in Croatia and is available for adoption to approved homes. Although he is outside the UK, full rescue procedures are followed.

Bear is microchipped, rabies vaccinated, and has received two rounds of infectious disease vaccinations. He will be castrated prior to adoption and has tested negative for Mediterranean diseases, including brucellosis.

A kennel cough nasal vaccination is also given before travel.

An adoption fee of £475 applies, along with a home check. Full rescue backup is provided by Nina’s Haven to support both Bear and his adopters after rehoming.

name: Idris
description:
Idris is a 2 year old male Dobermann. He is a calm and sensitive dog who has come from a difficult background, having originated from the meat trade in China. His experiences mean he can be shy when first meeting new people and environments.

Idris benefits from a gentle, patient approach and takes time to build trust. Once he feels safe and comfortable, his true personality shines through and he enjoys pottering about with his people. He forms steady bonds rather than instant ones, and those bonds are deeply rewarding.

He will need the guidance and reassurance of another dog in the home, as canine company helps him feel secure and learn appropriate behaviours.

Idris can live with all other dogs and gains confidence from their presence. A calm household with predictable routines will suit him best.

Idris is not house trained and will need continued support and training in this area. He is used to lead walks and will benefit from regular, structured exercise. A knowledgeable adopter who understands the Doberman breed is essential for his long-term success.

He is not suitable for a home with young children, as he requires a quiet and understanding environment. A calm home with someone experienced with the breed will help him continue to progress. Patience and consistency will be key to helping him settle.

name: Tuala
description:
Tuala is a 6 year old medium male Podengo Cross.

Tuala is Tan and White in colour and his coat is short in length.

Tuala’s nature is cheeky, playful and he loves walks.

Tuala came to the shelter because his owners didn’t want him anymore. He has already been in the shelter for 2 years but we don’t know why.

He has a huge character and is very cheeky. He loves to jump on your lap and is friendly with everyone he meets. If you want a perfectly behaved, obedient dog, Tuala isn’t for you.

If you want a cheeky boy who has a mind of his own, he is the perfect dog.

Tuala can get protective about food occasionally but he shares a kennel with other dogs and there is always food available so this can make him a bit protective.

We are sure this will settle in a home environment and with the right correction.

He loves his walks and he loves to play. He needs someone home most of the day.

name: Maxwell
description:
Meet Maxwell, also known as Max, Maxi, Maxi-Paxi, Maxi-Moo, or Mr Moo.

He is a 4–5 year old male Spanish Mastiff, large in size (around 60kg and approximately 35 inches at the shoulder), and currently in foster care. Maxwell is affectionate, calm, and a true gentle giant at heart.

Maxwell is crate trained, travels well in the car, and loves lounging on the sofa or leaning in for tummy rubs. He gets along with other dogs and could live with another dog or as an only dog with plenty of human company.

He is not suitable to live with cats. Maxwell is wonderful with children and currently lives happily with both a 10-month-old baby and a 15-year-old, whom he adores.

He is gentle, steady, and attentive, even alerting adults when the baby cries—a quiet guardian with a soft heart.

Maxwell enjoys walks, though lead training is still a work in progress. He responds well to gentle leadership, patience, and high-value rewards.

His recall is improving in secure areas. Maxwell will need a secure garden with solid 6ft fencing, as he can be curious and occasionally tempted by “adventures.”

Maxwell is affectionate, loyal, independent, and stubborn in the charming way typical of his breed. He is looking for an experienced home that understands large breeds and can provide a safe space, love, and plenty of sofa time for this gentle giant.

name: Ash
description:
Meet Ash, a 2 year old male German Shepherd Dog Cross who is medium in size and currently based in Nicosia, Cyprus, but available for rehoming in the UK.

Gorgeous Ash came to the rescue from a municipal pound where he was crying and desperately seeking attention. He is a German Shepherd Dog Cross, estimated to have been born on 03/12/2023, and weighs approximately 23 kilograms.

Ash is not just strikingly handsome, his personality is just as special. He is deeply affectionate, loves close contact, and often leans into people for comfort and reassurance.

He is cuddly, loving, and has a cheeky, funny nature that makes him a joy to be around. Ash forms bonds easily and thrives on human connection.

Ash already knows how to sit and give his paw, which suggests he previously lived in a home and understands basic training. He is intelligent, eager to learn, and responds well to interaction.

He is good with other dogs and walks nicely on the lead. Ash is sweet, loving, playful, and people-focused, and he would make a wonderful companion for the right home.

Ash has not yet been tested with cats or children, but this can be arranged if required.

Ash is currently in Cyprus and will be neutered, vaccinated, microchipped, treated for parasites, and travel with his own pet passport. He will also have rescue backup from Saving Souls Animal Rescue.

name: Baz
description:
Meet Baz, a 2 year old male Spaniel Cross-Breed who is medium in size and currently based in Cyprus, but available for rehoming in the UK.

Baz once had a home and a best friend named Spike, but when their owner left Cyprus, both dogs were abandoned on the streets. One of the rescue’s permanent volunteers discovered their situation and immediately brought them into care.

Spike has since secured a place with another rescue that has a wider adoption network, and it is hoped he will find his forever home soon. Now it is Baz’s turn.

Baz is approximately 2 years old, with an estimated date of birth of 23/11/2023, and currently weighs around 19 kilograms. He is a joyful, affectionate boy despite his difficult past and is full of personality.

Baz is a real social butterfly who gets very excited to see the volunteers and head out for his walks. He enjoys human interaction and brings a lot of positive energy wherever he goes.

He gets along well with other dogs and already knows how to sit for treats, although his enthusiasm sometimes gets the better of him, especially when food is involved.

Baz has not yet been tested with cats or children, but this can be arranged if required.

Due to having a docked tail, Baz urgently needs a home, as potential changes to UK regulations may affect his ability to travel in the future.

Baz is currently in Cyprus and is looking for a loving forever home either in Cyprus or the UK. He will be neutered, fully vaccinated, microchipped, treated for parasites, and rescue backup will be provided.

name: Betty
description:
Meet Betty, a 2 year old female Hound Cross-Breed who is medium in size and currently based in Cyprus, but available for rehoming in the UK.

This pretty girl weighs around 12 kilograms and was rescued from a local pound. When she was first found, Betty was curled up at the back of her kennel, trembling and barely showing herself, which was heartbreaking to see.

Since arriving in rescue, Betty has completely transformed. She has blossomed into a joyful and playful girl who loves meeting new furry friends. She is great with other dogs, always happy to greet the volunteers, and absolutely loves attention.

Betty now enjoys her walks and all the exciting smells along the way. She walks well on the lead and is growing in confidence every day.

Betty is not suitable to live with cats, and a cat-free home would be essential for her.

Her history before rescue is unknown, but her future is bright. From now on, she deserves nothing but love, safety, and stability in a forever home.

Betty is currently in Cyprus and will be neutered, vaccinated, microchipped, treated for parasites, and travel with her own pet passport. Rescue backup will be provided by Saving Souls Animal Rescue.

name: Bobby
description:
Bobby is a 3 year old medium male Cross-Breed.

Bobby is Black, Brown and White in colour and his coat is short in length.

Bobby’s nature is loving, affectionate and shy.

This lovely boy is Bobby, who was born in the shelter in Lousa, Portugal.

Bobby’s siblings and Mum were adopted a long time ago and for some reason he was the only one left. The shelter is all Bobby has ever known so he will need a family and home that can understand it will take him a long time to get used to the world.

He is very nervous of new people and will take a while to approach anyone but when he does he is a happy, sweet boy with lots of personality and love to share.

He really does deserve an amazing home where he can be given time and patience to feel safe and loved.

It wouldn’t be suitable for Bobby to be in a home with young children. He would need a calm and patient environment so he can be introduced to new sounds and people.

He needs someone who can give him the time and patience he deserves. Once he’s used to his environment he is a really lovely, affectionate boy to be around. Anyone would be lucky to have Bobby, he is really loved at the shelter.

name: Bruno
description:
Meet Bruno, a 2 year old male Labrador Retriever Cross-Breed who is large in size and currently based in Cyprus, but available for rehoming in the UK.

Bruno found himself in a shelter after his previous family had to leave the country and were unable to take him with them. Now, he is hoping for a second chance at a loving forever home.

Bruno is approximately 2 years old, with an estimated date of birth of 20/12/2023, and weighs around 30 kilograms. He can be a little cautious when meeting new people at first, but it does not take long for him to relax.

Once he feels comfortable, he becomes affectionate, playful, and enjoys cuddles and attention.

Bruno gets along very well with other dogs and enjoys their company. He loves going for walks, walks well on the lead, and has a playful side, especially when toys are involved.

Bruno has not yet been tested with cats or children, but this can be arranged if required.

Bruno is currently in Cyprus and will be neutered, vaccinated, microchipped, treated for parasites, and travel with his own pet passport. Rescue backup will be provided by Saving Souls Animal Rescue.

name: Enzo
description:
Enzo is a 6-year-old male Mastiff. He is neutered, vaccinated, and in good health, making him physically ready to settle into a new home environment.

Enzo has found himself in rescue due to a relationship break-up, and this situation is through absolutely no fault of his own.

Enzo can be initially wary when meeting new people, which is something to be expected given his circumstances. With calm, confident handling and the help of tasty treats, he quickly warms up and builds positive connections.

Once he feels comfortable, his friendly nature starts to shine through.

He is dog friendly and interacts well with other dogs, although he has never actually lived with another dog in a home setting. Any introductions would need to be managed carefully and sensibly to ensure everyone feels secure.

Enzo has no experience living with cats, so this would need to be considered in his future placement.

Enzo enjoys his daily walks and appreciates getting out and about, but he is equally content relaxing indoors. He loves nothing more than having a good snooze on the sofa or curling up in his own bed after a day of activity.

His balanced energy levels make him a pleasant companion to live with.

He has a solid foundation of basic obedience, which helps make day-to-day life easier and more enjoyable.

Enzo is also comfortable being left alone for around four to five hours, especially when his needs have been met with a walk beforehand. This suggests he can adapt well to a typical household routine.

Enzo has no experience with young children, so a home with dog-savvy teenagers would be more suitable for him. He would benefit from a calm, understanding household that can respect his boundaries and continue building his confidence.

With the right people, Enzo has the potential to be a loyal and loving companion.

name: Lucky
description:
Meet Lucky, a 4 year old male Cross-Breed who is large in size and currently based in Cyprus, but available for rehoming in the UK.

Lucky has had an incredibly tough start. He has been in the shelter since November 2022—almost three years—with no applications, despite being a gentle, affectionate, and beautiful boy.

He lives for his walks, adores people, and melts into cuddles like he’s been waiting his whole life for someone to notice him.

Lucky was found in a field with his paw trapped in a plastic bottle. One of his toes had to be amputated during recovery, but his spirit never wavered.

Now fully healed, he enjoys bounding around the play area, exploring on long walks with volunteers, and soaking up affection—but he still spends far too much time behind bars.

Lucky is selective with other dogs and must be an only dog. He has not yet been tested with cats or children, but this can be arranged if needed. He walks well on the lead and would thrive in a calm, loving, and attentive home.

Being the only dog, so he can be the center of attention

A family who sees beyond his shelter life and into his loving heart

Lucky is currently in Cyprus and will be neutered, vaccinated, microchipped, treated for parasites, and travel with his own pet passport. Rescue backup will be provided by Saving Souls Animal Rescue.

name: Patsy
description:
Patsy is a 1-year-old female Cross-Breed. She is a large dog with a short brown coat and a lively, playful personality that really stands out.

Patsy is affectionate by nature and clearly enjoys engaging with the people and dogs around her.

Patsy is described as a gorgeous girl who is full of energy and enthusiasm. She would suit an active home where she can burn off her energy and stay mentally stimulated.

She will need ongoing guidance to help her learn basic commands and develop good manners.

Patsy enjoys the company of other dogs and currently lives happily with her kennel mate Snoopy. She appears to get on better with male dogs than females, which is an important consideration for her future home.

Her social nature makes her well suited to a household with an existing male dog.

Patsy is a large dog, similar in size to a Labrador Retriever. If she were to live as an only dog, she would need plenty of patience, reassurance, and structured guidance.

With the right support, she can grow into a confident dog and continue learning about the world around her.

name: Nala
description:
Meet Nala, a 7 month old female German Shepherd Dog Cross who is medium in size and currently based in Cyprus, but available for rehoming in the UK.

Nala is one of sweet Sissy’s puppies. She and her siblings were born in a warehouse cared for by a friend of a permanent volunteer.

While one pup sadly did not survive, the rest were lovingly raised until they were ready to move to the shelter. Several of her siblings have already found homes, and now it’s Nala’s turn, along with her sibling Ira, to find a loving forever home.

Nala is approximately 7 months old, with an estimated date of birth 01/06/2025, and weighs around 18 kilograms. She will likely grow into a medium-large sized dog.

Nala is playful and enjoys being around people and other dogs, while also showing a calm and gentle side.

She is walking beautifully on the lead and has even started learning basic commands like “sit.”

Nala is good with other dogs and children, and she has not yet been tested with cats, but this can be arranged if required.

Nala is currently in Cyprus and will be vaccinated, microchipped, treated for parasites, and travel with her own pet passport. Rescue backup will be provided by Saving Souls Animal Rescue.

name: Ria
description:
Meet Ria, a 2 year old female Kangal Cross-Breed who is large in size and currently based in Cyprus, but available for rehoming in the UK.

Ria is just over 2 years old, with an estimated date of birth 28/09/2023, and weighs around 28 kilograms. She is a gentle, affectionate girl with a friendly and loving nature.

While she may be timid at first when meeting new people or encountering new situations, she quickly warms up and shows her soft, loyal side.

Ria is playful, enjoys walks, and gets along well with other dogs. She walks nicely on the lead and has low to medium energy levels, making her a great everyday companion.

She loves attention, cuddles, and treats, often leaning against her humans as if to say, “don’t forget me.”

Ria has had a challenging start to life. She was rescued after being found with her tongue stuck to her jaw, requiring surgery and recovery. Now fully healed, she is ready to find a forever home where she can receive the love and care she deserves.

She has not yet been tested with cats or children, but this can be arranged if required.

Ria is currently in Cyprus and will be neutered, vaccinated, microchipped, treated for parasites, and travel with her own pet passport. Rescue backup will be provided by Saving Souls Animal Rescue.

name: Olive
description:
Olive is a petite little Italian greyhound/ whippety shaped crossbreed aged around four years old.

Olive and her family went to Roxanas shelter in Romania from the Ukraine after the war broke out. They grew up there and now have the chance of a better future. Olive is the last of the four littermates to be adopted.

Olive is a lovely little girl but lacks confidence with new people and new situations. Once given time to get to know you she is such a happy and affectionate dog and loves attention and tummy rubs.

She has a beautiful smile which she shows you once she trusts you. She is initially shy but her cheeky side is just starting to show in her foster home. Olive is gaining confidence on walks but will need an adopter happy to continue with this.

Olive has a regal look and used to love sitting on top of the kennel in the shelter. Her best friend was a male labrador type and she mixes well with other dogs, so we feel a home with another dog would be her choice.

She could be equally as happy as the only dog in the home so long as the adopter can keep her well socialised and wants to spend a lot of time with their dog. She could live with respectful children aged twelve plus.

attributes.Breed: Staffordshire bull terrier cross german shepherd

name: Otis
description:
Otis is a handsome 4-month-old Staffordshire Bull Terrier x German Shepherd puppy with a wonderful personality and endless potential.

He is an intelligent, affectionate young dog who has already made incredible progress in foster care and is ready to find a family committed to continuing his journey.

When Otis first arrived in foster, he found the outside world overwhelming. Everyday sights and sounds such as traffic, strangers, butterflies, and other dogs made him feel worried and unsure.

Thanks to patient, reward-based training and consistent support, his confidence has grown tremendously, and he continues to make fantastic progress every day.

Otis is a typical puppy who loves to play, explore, and be involved in everything his family is doing. He is incredibly people-focused and has earned the nickname of a “Velcro dog” because he simply loves being close to his humans.

He is already fully house trained, crate trained, and happily sleeps through the night. Otis settles well in his crate and can currently be left for around three hours without any issues.

He has lovely manners around the home and is not destructive, although tennis balls don’t tend to last very long around him!

Otis is exceptionally intelligent and eager to learn. He is highly food motivated and already knows a range of commands including sit, stay, leave, come, walk, look, kiss, and drop.

His recall is developing well, and he walks beautifully on a loose lead, making him an absolute pleasure to train.

He enjoys an active lifestyle and loves games of fetch, football, tug, water play, rope toys, tennis balls, and scent games. He will thrive in a home that enjoys training, enrichment, and including him in everyday adventures.

Otis currently lives happily with an 8-year-old child and has shown himself to be gentle and affectionate. He could happily live with sensible, dog-savvy children who understand that he is still a young puppy learning about the world.

He also enjoys the company of other dogs. Although initially nervous of his foster family’s resident dogs, he quickly built wonderful relationships with them and now loves playing and interacting with them.

Outside the home, he can still feel unsure around unfamiliar dogs and may occasionally bark or lunge. This behaviour is fear-based rather than aggressive, and with continued guidance and confidence-building, he is making excellent progress.

Cats and small animals have not been formally assessed, although Otis has happily ignored cats and birds while out on walks.

Otis would suit a family who are committed to continuing his positive, reward-based training while helping him build confidence at his own pace.

He needs patient owners who understand that he is still very much a puppy and who will provide plenty of love, structure, enrichment, and reassurance as he continues to develop.

Otis is an incredibly special young dog with a bright future ahead of him. Given the right guidance and continued encouragement, he will grow into a loyal, affectionate, and devoted companion who will reward his family with a lifetime of love and adventures.

name: Denzel
description:
Denzel is fostered in Mattishall Norfolk.

Denzel is a small to medium-sized crossbreed, around 2 to 3 years old, with the cutest little legs and a long body that suggests there might be a bit of Corgi and Spaniel somewhere in his family tree.

Whatever his mix, one thing is certain, he’s absolutely adorable.

Denzel’s story didn’t begin with the love and security every dog deserves. He was rescued from a pack of dogs surviving on the streets of Romania, in an area where cruelty towards dogs was sadly commonplace.

Many of the dogs rescued alongside him had suffered horrific injuries, including broken limbs. Miraculously, Denzel escaped without any major physical injuries, but the emotional scars of his past are harder to see.

Because of this, Denzel is understandably cautious around new people. He isn’t the sort of dog who will throw himself into the arms of strangers, and that’s okay.

He simply needs someone willing to let him go at his own pace. The beautiful thing about Denzel is that once you’ve earned his trust, his cheeky, affectionate personality begins to shine through.

He’s sweet, quietly funny, and has so much love tucked away, just waiting for the right person to discover it.

Denzel is currently living happily in a multi-dog foster home and absolutely thrives with canine company. Watching him with the other dogs is lovely!

He’s relaxed, confident, and enjoys playing when he thinks the humans aren’t looking! Because of how much he relies on other dogs for reassurance, he will need at least one friendly, confident resident dog in his forever home.

Cats, however… let’s just say the relationship between Denzel and the Safe Rescue cat is less of a friendship and more of a mutual agreement to disagree! For that reason, he is looking for a cat-free home.

Denzel could happily live with sensible, respectful children aged 12 years and over who understand that he will need time, patience and space to settle.

Denzel isn’t looking for perfection. He isn’t looking for someone who expects an instant best friend. He’s looking for someone who understands that love built on trust is worth waiting for.

If you’re the kind of person who celebrates the little victories… a first tail wag, a gentle nudge for affection, a dog choosing to lie beside you because he finally feels safe, then Denzel might just be the one you’ve been waiting for.

name: Boris
description:
Boris is a large sized crossbreed aged around 11 years old.Boris fostered Watton, Norfolk.

Boris is a large dog who is unaware that his size doesn’t equate to him being a lap dog, however hard he tries. He is a gentle giant who loves nothing more than nuzzling up to his foster family for cuddles and kisses.

He spends most of his time as if a shadow of his fosterers, wherever we go, he goes. Whatever you are doing in the house, Boris will be right there by your side.

He loves his walks and can be out for quite some time, he also likes going to an enclosed field for a runaround and his favourite activity, a roll in the grass. He walks wonderfully on the lead and plods along nicely.

He loves his humans and gets the zoomies daily when his fosterers get home from work, as well as an incredibly waggy tail.

Apart from his spurts of energy, Boris is a very chilled out dude who likes the simple things of walks, food, fuss, and sleep.

Boris currently lives in a home with other dogs but would be quite happy to be the only dog in the house, where attention to him can be undivided. He cannot live with cats. He needs an adult home.

name: Zoey
description:
Our extra special girl Zoey is approximately three years old and a rather small but staggering pretty cross breed. Zoey weighs just nine kilos and measures eleven inches from shoulder to paw.

Having been found abandoned on the streets, Zoey has been in our Cyprus shelter for approaching one year.

Our shelter manager describes Zoey as shy but very loving once she gains confidence with her humans.

Zoey has a glorious smile, a shining black coat with a white flash to her chest, beautiful engaging brown eyes and the most affable disposition.

She will unquestionably blend perfectly into a loving family who will enjoy so many years of love and affection.

Zoey’s amazing personality shines through especially when she’s on a lap or having a cuddle.

Zoey walks nicely on her lead but could benefit from additional training. She seems to mix perfectly well with other dogs, cats and children.

name: Reggie
description:
Reggie is a truly wonderful boy with a heart as big as his beautiful smile.

This handsome 3-year-old English Setter x Springer Spaniel cross has an incredibly calm, gentle and affectionate nature. He loves people, enjoys the company of other dogs and is simply happiest when he’s close to those who care for him.

Reggie’s story is an extraordinary one. He somehow walked more than 30 kilometres back to his home town, where we found him wandering.

After scanning his microchip and making enquiries, it became clear that returning him to his previous owner was not in his best interests.

Instead, Reggie was given the chance to find what every dog deserves—a loving, secure forever home where he will be cherished as part of the family.

Now safe in our small, cage-free home rescue in Bulgaria, Reggie is thriving. He’s well-mannered, relaxed and affectionate, making him an ideal companion for someone looking for a loyal best friend.

Whether it’s country walks, relaxing in the garden or curling up beside you after a day out, Reggie will be happiest simply being with his people.

Reggie is looking for a family who will love him for the rest of his life and ensure he never has to wander in search of kindness again.

MicrochipPet passportFull vaccinations including rabiesBlood testsFlea and worm treatmentNeuteringDEFRA-approved transport from Bulgaria to the UKLifetime rescue supportIf you think Reggie could be the perfect addition to your family, we’d love to hear from you.

We consider all applicants because finding the right match is what matters most.

name: Roxi
description:
Meet Roxi, a 9 month old female Cross-Breed who is medium in size and currently based in Cyprus, but available for rehoming in the UK.

Roxi is one of four puppies who were found abandoned in a remote area.

Thanks to the dedication of one of the rescue’s volunteers—who visited them twice a day for two months with patience, calmness, and food—the puppies slowly began to trust humans.

When they were finally brought into the shelter, they were terrified, hiding under pallets and unsure of the world around them.

In just a few weeks, Roxi’s confidence grew remarkably. She came out of her shell, became affectionate, and began showing her playful, cheeky personality.

Her siblings Benson and Astrid have already found forever homes, and now Roxi, along with her sister Mabel, are still waiting for their chance.

Roxi is approximately 9 months old, with an estimated date of birth 02/04/2025, and weighs around 14 kilograms.

She is a shy but gentle soul, a little reserved with new people at first, but once she feels safe, she becomes playful, happy, and full of personality.

She walks well on the lead, gets along with other dogs, and enjoys spending time in the play area with dogs of all ages and sizes. Roxi can also learn to live with cats and would be suitable for a family with children once tested.

Roxi is currently in Cyprus and will be vaccinated, microchipped, treated for parasites, and travel with her own pet passport. Rescue backup will be provided by Saving Souls Animal Rescue.

name: Shelley
description:
Shelley is an 18 month old female Cross-Breed with the sweetest nature and is looking for a loving forever home in the UK.

She was rescued after being found wandering alone around a petrol station in Bulgaria.

Understandably, Shelley was nervous when she first came into our care, but with patience, kindness, and the security of our home-based rescue, she has completely transformed.

Today, Shelley is a happy, affectionate little dog who absolutely adores people. She has become a true “Velcro Dog”, always wanting to be close to her humans.

If there’s a lap available, Shelley will happily claim it! She loves cuddles, enjoys relaxing on the sofa, and simply wants to be part of family life.

Shelley lives in our small, cage-free home rescue alongside other dogs and has settled in beautifully. She is fully house trained, has lovely manners around the home, and enjoys the company of both people and dogs.

She would make a wonderful companion for someone looking for a loyal, affectionate dog who enjoys close human company.

Whether it’s gentle walks, relaxing in the garden, or curling up together in the evening, Shelley will be happiest wherever her family is.

Shelley could happily live with another friendly dog or as the only dog in the home where she will receive plenty of love and attention.

As she was nervous when first rescued, we feel she would be best suited to a calm home with children aged 10 years and over.

MicrochipPet passportFull vaccinations, including rabiesBlood testsFlea and worm treatmentSpayingDEFRA-approved transport to the UKLifetime rescue support

If you think Shelley could be the perfect addition to your family, we’d love to hear from you.

We consider all applicants because finding the right home for every dog is what matters most.

name: Wilma
description:
Wilma is a 2-year-old female Rottweiler. She has come into rescue due to her owner’s health, meaning she now needs a new home through no fault of her own. Despite the changes she has experienced, she is described as a really sweet girl.

She has led quite a sheltered life, as her previous home was secluded and had its own land. Because of this, she will need a quieter home environment with slow and careful introductions to the outside world.

New experiences may be overwhelming at first, so she will benefit from patient adopters who understand her background. A calm and supportive approach will help her build confidence at her own pace.

She could be rehomed with Shelby, who she came into rescue with, as they are already familiar with each other. Alternatively, she may be able to live with other large breed dogs, subject to successful introductions at the rescue.

If she is to live as an only dog, she will need a home where someone is around most of the time. She enjoys company and would not be suited to being left alone for long periods.

She is not suitable to live with cats, small furries, or young children. A calm household that matches her needs would give her the best chance to settle and thrive.

name: Scooby
description:
Meet Scooby, a 7.5 year old male Hound Cross-Breed who is medium-large in size and currently based in Cyprus, but available for rehoming in the UK.

Scooby was found roaming the streets in poor condition, extremely underweight, and skeletal. With time, love, and proper care, he has made a remarkable recovery. Now healthy, tall, and handsome, Scooby is playful, affectionate, and full of joy.

He enjoys walks, human interaction, and cuddles, and is very food-oriented, which makes training a pleasure. Scooby remains energetic and curious, always eager to explore and please.

Scooby gets along with most dogs but can be selective with some males. Because of this, he would do best in a home with a friendly female dog or as the only dog. He has not yet been tested with cats or children, but this can be arranged if required.

Scooby is not yet house or crate trained. He walks well on the lead and responds well to positive guidance.

Scooby is currently in Cyprus and will be neutered, vaccinated, microchipped, treated for parasites, and travel with his own pet passport. Rescue backup will be provided by Saving Souls Animal Rescue.

name: Wilbur
description:
Meet Wilbur, a 1 year old male Hound Cross-Breed who is medium in size and currently based in Cyprus, but available for rehoming in the UK.

Wilbur was found wandering in a village in Nicosia and brought into rescue. He weighs around 17 kilograms and has a sweet, affectionate, and playful personality.

Wilbur loves human contact, enjoys cuddles, and has a joyful, energetic spirit.

He is good with other dogs and children, and has not yet been tested with cats, though this can be arranged if needed.

Wilbur is eager to learn to walk nicely on the lead and enjoys playtime, though he can play a little rough with other dogs—always with love.

Wilbur has beautiful eyes, a unique coat, and adorable floppy ears, making him as charming as he is friendly.

He is looking for a home that will shower him with attention, play, and affection.

Wilbur is currently in Cyprus and will be neutered, vaccinated, microchipped, treated for parasites, and travel with his own pet passport.

Rescue backup will be provided by Saving Souls Animal Rescue.

name: Amlet
description:
Hello, friends! My name is Amlet, and I’m a sweet?natured, friendly black Labrador cross, around 7 years young. For the past three years I’ve been living at CyDRA shelter, patiently waiting for a forever home. Could it finally be with you?

I might not love labels, but I do embrace one classic Labrador trait with pride: I absolutely love food!

After what I’ve been through, I think I’ve earned it. I also love water—paddling in the sea, splashing in puddles, even a good hose?down makes me wiggle with joy.

And my favourite game is chasing my ball; I’m a keen fetch partner and will happily play until it’s time for cuddles and a nap.

You see, I spent my entire life chained up, barely surviving on scraps of food and little water. Then one day, everything changed.

A kind stranger saw me and contacted the vet services, who called in a rescue team. That’s how I finally got a chance at a better life—and moved into the shelter, where I learned what it means to be treated with love and respect.

Because of my difficult past, I can be a little unsure around other dogs at first. With slow, gentle introductions, I warm up—and once I trust, I love deeply.

I’ve happily shared my kennel with several female dog friends, and I do best in calm, respectful company.

There’s still so much of life I haven’t experienced—exploring new walks, splashing on adventures, playing ball in the garden, and cuddles on the couch—but I’m ready to start now.

I’m looking for a quiet, loving home where I can feel safe, relax, and show off my affectionate personality (and yes, my adorable fluffy tail).

*Peaceful and patient, with time for gentle training and reassurance.*Either as an only dog or with a calm female companion.*Access to outdoor fun—water play and ball games are my happy place!

I’m ready to pack my bags. Will you be the one to open your heart and welcome me home?

name: Shelby
description:
Shelby is a 6-year-old male Rottweiler. He came into rescue due to his owner’s ill health, meaning he needs a new home through no fault of his own. His background explains a lot about his sensitive but gentle nature.

He was rescued as a puppy after being found tied to a tree with a head injury, which has understandably shaped how he feels about handling. Because of this, he can be worried about touch until he feels safe and trusts the person with him.

Once he gets to know you, his true personality shines through and he shows what a really sweet boy he is. Calm, confident handling and a pocket full of treats help him relax quickly, and he will soon start initiating contact himself.

He enjoys company and would struggle in a home where he is left alone for long periods. If he is to be an only dog, he would need adopters who are around most of the time.
