He could live with Wilma, who came into rescue with him, or with other large breed dogs following successful introductions at the rescue. He is not suitable to live with cats or young children.

He does have an underlying health condition, but it is currently causing him no issues and can be fully discussed with anyone interested in offering him a home. With the right environment, he has the potential to be a loyal and loving companion.

name: Sylvester
description:
Meet Sylvester, a 1 year old male Cross-Breed, a young boy who has had a bit of an unlucky start since coming over to the UK as a puppy.

Having already been surrendered twice, he is currently in a foster home that does not suit him as well as originally hoped.

Sylvester would adore a retired family or someone who works from home, as he suffers from quite severe separation anxiety.

His foster has been working on this, but he is likely to take a step backwards again when he moves, as he simply does not know where to call home anymore.

He is anxious around the male in the home, although he has previously lived with men without any reaction.

His foster is struggling to walk him, as he can be anxious outside, so he will need an experienced and confident owner who is comfortable walking a nervous dog.

Sylvester thrives around other dogs and takes both confidence and comfort from them. He would love to live with a confident canine companion who can help guide him, with plenty of playtime along the way too.

NeuteredVaccinatedMicrochippedBlood tests completedFlea treatedWormedPassport ready

Sylvester needs a patient, understanding home where he can finally feel safe and secure. With the right environment and support, he has the potential to truly blossom.

name: Kira
description:
Welcome the beautiful girl, Kira. Kira is a 2 year old female German Shepherd Cross who embodies everything German Shepherd lovers adore: intelligent, loyal, affectionate, eager to learn, and deeply connected to her humans.

Kira thrives on engagement and routine, and she is longing for a home where she can finally relax. She would thrive with someone who understands German Shepherds and their emotional needs.

Kira loves humans. She bonds deeply and wants nothing more than to be someone’s loyal, devoted companion. Cuddling and being close to her people is one of her favourite things, together with being brushed and pampered.

Kira travels well in the car. She jumps in happily and settles beautifully.

She has a clean bill of health, including full X-rays of her legs, hips, and joints, which were all excellent.

Do you have German Shepherd experience? Would you love a bright, affectionate, loyal girl by your side? Could you offer her a foster home, or even better, her forever home?

Kira is waiting for someone to see her, choose her, and give her the life she deserves.

Kira can fly as early as January 25th, 2026.

name: Maddox
description:
Maddox is now in foster in Hartlepool. Looking for adoption.

He is a gentle giant. Very calm, great with all dogs & people. Walks well on the lead.

Maddox is a large dog, weighing about 40 kg and standing approximately 60 cm tall.

He is a big, friendly, gentle giant who has waited a long time for his forever home.

Maddox is a great dog who simply loves other dogs and adores humans. With his lovable and fun nature, Maddox would make a wonderful addition to any home.

He is neutered, fully vaccinated, and microchipped, ensuring that he is ready for his new life in the UK.

Once all checks have been completed, Maddox will be delivered directly to your door.

The adoption comes with lifetime rescue backup, providing ongoing support.

Maddox’s gentle and affectionate personality makes him an ideal candidate for a loving home, where he can finally find the happiness he deserves.

He eagerly awaits the chance to become a cherished member of a family, ready to share his love and joy.

name: Mason
description:
Meet Mason, a 4 year old male Newfoundland cross Belgian Malinois Cross who is large in size and has a sensitive nature with lots of love to give once he builds trust.

Mason was born in approximately April 2021. He weighs around 30 kilograms and appears to have Newfoundland and Belgian Malinois heritage.

Mason is a handsome golden boy with a gentle soul. He is affectionate, a little goofy, intelligent, and sometimes charmingly stubborn.

With the people he knows and trusts, Mason is a gentle and loving presence. He likes to sit nearby, enjoys calm affection when fully awake, and finds comfort in being close to his people.

He is very food motivated, which makes training enjoyable and effective, and he gets excited when the lead comes out, as walks are one of his favourite activities.

Mason can be wary of strangers at first. He may bark and keep his distance until he has had a chance to assess the situation. Once he realises someone is safe, he relaxes and shows his friendly, tail-wagging side.

With other dogs: Mason is very friendly and enthusiastic. He enjoys meeting other dogs, approaches with excitement, and loves a good sniff. He may attempt to mount, so continued training and guidance will help him learn polite greetings.

With cats: Mason is not suitable to live with cats, as he will bark and attempt to chase.With visitors: Mason finds unfamiliar people overwhelming and will bark and retreat if approached.Around noise: Loud or sudden noises can worry him, and he will look to move somewhere quieter.

Mason can be reactive in certain situations, especially if startled when asleep or approached while tired. He needs patient guardians who can read his signals, give him space when needed, and continue building his confidence using positive methods.

He can be stubborn, particularly if he is comfortable or wants to go a different direction on a walk, but he responds well to calm and consistent guidance.

Health and groomingMason sheds lightly throughout the year, with heavier seasonal moults, so regular brushing is needed. He may experience mild skin irritation after running through long grass, which can be managed with seasonal allergy tablets.

Mason’s ideal homeMason will thrive in a home that can offer experienced adult owners who understand reactive or sensitive dogs, a calm and predictable environment, and a secure garden. Another friendly dog could be beneficial for companionship, but this is not essential.

Why Mason is worth itMason is a wonderful dog with great potential. With the right home, patience, and understanding, he will form a deep bond and show his affectionate and playful nature. He is loyal, intelligent, food motivated, and eager to be part of a stable and loving home where he feels safe.

If you have experience with reactive dogs and can provide the steady environment Mason needs, he will reward you with trust, companionship, and plenty of golden-furred affection.

name: Mara
description:
Welcome lovely Mara, a 1 year 6 month old female Cross-Breed.

Lovely Mara is a beautiful and friendly girl who was rescued as a young pup after being mistreated. She has been safe at the shelter since September 2024, where she has continued to grow in confidence and personality.

Despite her difficult start in life, Mara has blossomed into a cheeky, affectionate dog who enjoys human companionship. She can live happily with other dogs and can be cat tested if needed. With sensible introductions, she may be able to live with older, dog-savvy children.

As a young dog, Mara will need ongoing training and guidance to help her learn and settle into home life, and she would benefit from owners who are patient and committed to continuing positive training.

Mara is comfortable being on her own and can be left for a few hours, making her a good match for a home that is not always busy. She would really benefit from a home with access to a secure garden, as she enjoys spending time outdoors.

Mara is spayed, fully vaccinated, and in good health. She weighs approximately 20 kg and measures around 55 cm in height and 70 cm in length.

This lovely young girl would thrive in a home that can offer her love, stability, and the chance to enjoy life beyond the shelter. Mara truly deserves a family of her own where she can continue to grow and feel safe.

Full rescue backup and support throughout the adoption process and for the lifetime of the dog.

name: Walter
description:
Walter is a 4-year-old male Cross-Breed. He is a medium-sized dog weighing 26kg and is currently in North Lanarkshire, Scotland.

He is sadly searching for a new home after his owner experienced a serious health emergency and can no longer care for him.

Walter forms very strong bonds with his person and is described as incredibly cuddly and loving once he knows you. He and his previous owner were especially close, which makes this change particularly difficult for him.

Because of this, he can feel anxious around new people and unfamiliar dogs.

His anxiety can sometimes show itself as reactive behaviour. On one occasion, he redirected his fear and did use his teeth on his adopter, which highlights that he needs understanding and careful management.

He can also be startled by sudden movements, which can add to his worries in new situations.

Despite this, Walter is not without his softer and more social side. He can be super friendly with other dogs and is able to play very nicely with them. With the right introductions and calm guidance, he has the potential to enjoy canine company.

Walter’s ideal home would be an adult-only environment. He needs patient people who are willing to give him a second chance and help him feel safe again. A calm household with a steady routine would help him build confidence over time.

One of Walter’s absolute favourite activities is running around in a secure field. In these safe spaces, he recalls beautifully and clearly enjoys the freedom to move. This kind of outlet will be important for his wellbeing and happiness.

name: Wallace
description:
Wonderful Wallace is a 1 year 9 month old male German Shepherd cross Siberian Husky. He is a playful, intelligent, and active boy looking for an equally active owner.

He likes to be outdoors and is inquisitive about his surroundings but can become overwhelmed at times and bark at things he is unsure of, including strangers.

He will need an experienced and understanding person who can provide support and guidance when needed. He wears a muzzle when out and about purely as a safety precaution. However, Wallace is very affectionate with people he knows. He loves to lean in for attention and builds very strong bonds.

He really enjoys his training and thrives on having a purpose. This handsome chap would suit owners who have the time and patience to continue his training and socialisation, as well as providing plenty of mental stimulation to keep him busy.

He will make an incredibly fun, loving, and rewarding best friend in the right home.

Wallace is looking for an active, all-adult home. To help with his training, it would be ideal if he could find a home in a rural or semi-rural area.

He can live in a flat as long as there is direct access to a private garden. He could potentially live with another well-matched dog, subject to a successful meet at Mayhew.

His new owner will be expected to continue his training and socialisation and will receive three free one-to-one sessions with a Mayhew Animal Behaviourist to help guide them.

Wallace has been neutered, microchipped, and vaccinated and is up to date with flea and worm treatment. He has also been health checked and behaviourally assessed.

Lastly, every dog adopted from Mayhew will go home with four weeks of free pet insurance.

name: Vilo
description:
Vilo is a 3.5-year-old male Griffon Fauve de Bretagne. He was originally found in a Spanish pound before being taken into rescue and moved to a foster home in Spain. He is still there now, waiting patiently for a place to call his own.

He is described as a good dog who enjoys cuddles and human company. Vilo gets along well with both adults and children, showing a friendly and affectionate nature. His gentle side makes him a lovely companion in the home.

While he is fine with most dogs when out on walks, Vilo cannot live with another dog in the household. For this reason, he will need to be rehomed as the only dog so he can feel secure and relaxed in his environment.

Clear boundaries and a calm home setup will help him thrive.

Vilo’s health checks have been thorough and reassuring. He has tested negative for five Mediterranean diseases as well as Brucellosis. He is also fully vaccinated and up to date with his parasite treatments.

His new home must have a well-fenced garden. This will give him a safe outdoor space to enjoy fresh air and explore securely. A private garden will be an important part of meeting his needs.

Vilo remains in Spain at present and is waiting for the right family to come along. He offers affection, companionship, and a steady presence in return for a safe and loving home.

With the right setup, he has all the qualities to become a deeply devoted pet.

name: Forest
description:
Meet Forest, a 5 year 11 month old male Cross-Breed with a gentle soul and a big heart.

Friendly Forest is a gentle and loving boy who was found abandoned in the forest (hence his name) and has been safe at the shelter since 2021.

Forest is a sociable and well-mannered companion who adores human company and enjoys spending time with people he knows and trusts.

He is happy to live either with other dogs or as an only dog, and he is comfortable being left alone at home for reasonable periods. With appropriate introductions, he may be able to live with dog-savvy children aged 10 and above.

Forest has not yet been tested with cats, but this can be done if required.

He would thrive in a home that can offer access to a secure garden, as he loves having outdoor space to explore, relax, and enjoy a peaceful life.

Forest is neutered, fully vaccinated, and in good health. He weighs approximately 25 kg and measures around 50 cm in height and 70 cm in length.

This lovely boy has waited far too long for his chance at a forever home and would make a wonderful, loyal companion for the right family.

Full rescue backup and support throughout the adoption process and for the lifetime of the dog.

name: Blue
description:
Blue is a 3 year old Cane Corso mix currently based in Poole, Dorset. Unfortunately, his family have made the heartbreaking decision to rehome him.

Sadly, he and the resident dog have started to clash, and they feel that Blue would be happier and more settled as the only dog, where he can have the space, attention and stability he thrives on.

Blue is a big boy at around 50kg, but those who know him best describe him as a giant softie at heart.

He loves his toys, especially chasing a ball or a good game of tug, and food is very much a highlight of his day – be careful what you leave lying around!

At home, Blue’s favourite thing in the world is being close to his family. He adores cuddling up on the sofa in front of the fire, resting his huge head in your lap, and will happily curl up on the bed.

He likes to follow you from room to room and takes real comfort in being by your side. He is a truly devoted companion once he’s formed a bond with you.

Around people, Blue is friendly and affectionate. He will bark when someone rings the doorbell, taking his role as home protector seriously, but once told to go to his bed he settles straight away, reassured that everything is under control.

He has grown up around young children and has also spent time with older children without any issues, always gentle and tolerant.

Blue enjoys a good long walk and walks beautifully on a halti.

Because of his size he can look intimidating to others, but he is well managed on lead and kept close to his handler when other dogs are around, just to give everyone the comfort that he is very much under control.

His recall is excellent, he responds reliably to commands such as sit, down, stay, come, leave and bed, and he works best with positive reinforcement and high value treats.

Despite his giant appearance, Blue is a sensitive soul and responds much better to kindness and consistency than to being told off. He’s just a baby at heart.

Blue is generally fine around other dogs, and his family are so upset to be making this decision, especially as at the start he and the resident dog were good friends.

However, we feel now that he would much prefer to be someone’s one and only, soaking up all the love and attention and forming a strong bond.

He is crate trained and house trained, and has learned so many good behaviours and commands since being adopted. He will be perfect for someone looking for their dream soulmate dog, because that’s what he is.

Blue is looking for an active, experienced owner or couple who understand large, powerful breeds and are happy to continue his training in a calm, consistent way.

He would suit a quiet, organised home without other pets, where he is not left alone for long periods and where sofa cuddles are very much part of daily life.

For the right person, he will be an incredibly devoted best friend who just wants to be close and loved. In return, Blue will genuinely love you more than anything in the world.

name: Benji
description:
Meet Benji, a 1.5 year old male Cross-Breed who is medium in size and full of personality.

Hey there. I am Benji, and my superpower is turning ordinary moments into laugh-out-loud ones. I have a charming personality, or so I have been told, and a serious talent for making humans smile.

Bonus points if you are handing out cuddles, because I love those as much as I love, well, everyone.

Out and about, I greet the world with bright enthusiasm. I am friendly with people of all ages, and I offer polite bows and cheerful hellos to the dogs I meet.

When the pace slows, I am happy to ease from play into calm, leaning in for gentle affection and settling close.

I have not experienced living in a home yet, but with patient guidance and kindness, I am ready to learn what relaxed downtime looks like and bring plenty of joy to the moments we share.

I am clever and proudly food-motivated, so training with me is fun and fast. Show me once, reward me kindly, and I will nail it.

I enjoy puzzle toys, sniffy adventures, and short training sessions that make my brain fizz, little bursts of learning that add up to big wins.

I can live happily as your one and only or fit right in with doggy siblings. What I am wishing for is an active, kind home with daily walks, playtime, and a bit of mental stimulation to keep my bright mind engaged.

You bring consistency, kindness, and a pocket of snacks; I will bring loyalty, laughter, and a tail that never runs out of wag.

name: Tito
description:
Tito is a 4 year old large male Beagle Cross.

Tito is Black, Brown and White in colour and his coat is long in length.

Tito’s nature is sweet, gentle and he loves to cuddle.

Tito came to the shelter with his siblings when he was around 3 months old. We don’t know his history because he just appeared. Someone broke in at night and left the puppies there absolutely terrified.

For a long time communication with Tito was very difficult. A couple were interested in adopting Tito so they invested a fair amount of time coming and walking him and he improved a great deal.

However, they were ultimately unable to offer him a home.

With time and patience Tito will be a lovely dog. He’s shy and scared of unknown situations but he is such a lovely boy and we believe worth the commitment.

He gets on well with other dogs in his kennel and his leisure time is spent playing with approximately 12 dogs. Because of his lack of confidence Tito should only be homed with another dog.

name: Dukey
description:
Meet Dukey, a 7-8 year old male dog of unknown breed who is currently in foster kennels in Romania.

Dukey is in foster kennels in Romania. He was saved from Lancram kill shelter in August 2021, coming up to five years ago. This is so sad.

He is not one of Just Kind Dog Rescue’s dogs, but I was involved in taking him out of Lancram and now, with your help, I am trying to find him a home.

Dukey is 7 to 8 years old and 50 cm tall. It has taken time, but this boy now allows contact; he just needs to be approached slowly, with no quick moves. He is friendly and not aggressive in any way, he just needs time to build up his trust. He is a timid, gentle boy.

He has been on a lead but definitely needs training with this. So far, when tried, he does not like it.

Are you looking for a handsome boy? Look no further, Dukey is here.

7-8 years old.50 cm tall.Approx 28 kg.Neutered.Vaccinated.Dewormed and deflead.Passport and health book.Delivered to your door.Rescue back-up for life through Just Kind Dog Rescue

name: Gypsy
description:
Meet Gypsy, an 11 year old female Poodle Cross Jack Russell Terrier.

Gypsy came to us in a poor state, and it appears she previously lived outdoors, possibly under a caravan. Her expectations of human care were minimal, and she would not come into the house unless encouraged. She has had a couple of litters in her past.

Despite this neglect, Gypsy is the sweetest little girl we have fostered. She has a gentle and affectionate nature and is an absolute joy to be around. Her only quirk is that she becomes excited by the scent of foxes and may bark.

Gypsy was not initially house-trained, but after three days of constant monitoring she is now clean in the house and no longer needs to be crated at night. She has settled beautifully and continues to be a very good girl.

Health-wise, Gypsy is on a raw diet as it is clear she is allergic to kibble. Her ears require daily cleaning, and she was previously chewing her paws, which has reduced significantly. Her paws are not in poor condition.

Gypsy is friendly with people and other dogs but is not suitable to live with cats. She is independent in nature and tends to do her own thing, calmly ignoring most distractions.

She is food-oriented and would be happy living with another friendly dog. Two 30-minute walks per day suit her well, as she enjoys getting out and about and is now comfortable walking off lead.

Gypsy would make a wonderful companion for an older person, provided she continues on a raw diet and receives her daily walks.

She will need ongoing help with ear care and is slightly deaf, although her hearing has improved as her ears have been cleaned. The ear canals remain somewhat swollen due to past neglect.

Gypsy now loves the warmth and comfort of indoor life and enjoys choosing between the sofa and her bed. This lovely little girl truly deserves a caring home with a garden where she can enjoy her retirement years in comfort.

name: Ollie
description:
*** OLLIE WILL COME TO FOSTER IN BANSTEAD, SURREY, ON 13TH SEPTEMBER 2026 ***

Our extra special boy Ollie is around three years old and a rather small cross breed of unknown origin. Ollie weighs just seven kilos and measures nine inches from shoulder to paw.

His arrival two weeks ago was a little odd. Ollie was handed to the night watchman saying found on the streets, but we suspect he was surrendered by uncaring owners.

Our shelter manager describes Ollie as well cared for but completely overwhelmed by shelter life and dismayed that he finds himself there. He is a very sweet and loving little dog who thoroughly deserves to be in his forever home soonest.

Being a quiet and low maintenance fellow Ollie absolutely enjoys one to one with his human companions and savours a cuddle and pep talk.

Ollie represents an ideal opportunity for an experienced adopter who can offer him a good quality and loving life. An absolute joy.

Ollie seems to mix perfectly well with other dogs, cats and children. He walks nicely on his lead.

name: King
description:
King is a 2-year-old male German Shepherd Dog Cross. He’s a large, striking boy, weighing in at 30kg, and currently living in a shelter in Cyprus after being picked up as a stray in May 2024.

Like many German Shepherds, King is intelligent, confident, and full of energy. He thrives on human interaction and gets genuinely thrilled whether you’re an old pal or someone he’s meeting for the first time.

King loves getting out of his kennel for walks and exercise. He’s got a playful streak and enjoys burning off energy, which is essential for a dog his size and strength.

Despite his boisterous nature, he’s gentle when taking treats from staff and volunteers and shows clear signs of wanting to please. He’s food-motivated, which will make training more straightforward for an experienced owner.

Speaking of which—King needs someone who’s handled strong, energetic dogs before. He’ll benefit from consistent training, particularly on the lead and with basic commands.

His personality is pure Shepherd: loyal, driven, and always ready for action. He just needs the right guidance to channel it all.

He’s good with other dogs and could either live with a female dog or be perfectly content as the only pup in the household. His reaction to cats is unknown, so caution would be wise if introducing him to feline friends.

As for kids, he’s best suited to a home with children over 10 years old. He’s playful and may not realise just how big and powerful he really is.

King isn’t just another rescue dog—he’s a diamond waiting to shine. All he needs is a chance, a home, and someone willing to invest in his future. With love, patience, and training, he’ll become a truly incredible companion.

name: Pascal
description:
Pascal is a 2 year old male Crossbreed currently in kennels in Worcester, urgently seeking a female-only foster or adopter to help him decompress.

Pascal is urgently seeking a female-only foster or adopter to take him in and help him decompress. Having recently moved into kennels, Pascal has found the past few months as his difficulties with accepting his male carer in foster caused additional stresses.

Highly lovable, Pascal is unfortunately not able to show this side of his personality, so his future fosterer or adopter is asked to have extra patience and understanding whilst he settles and learns to make friends.

Pascal has been in the UK for a while now and at 2 years old, he enjoys his adventures and human interaction within his trusted circle.

He is kindly asking that someone opens their home to him but doesn’t ask too much at first as he struggles with change. He would love a garden to explore and a quiet area in the home to call his own. Although he can be left, he prefers to have company so any time on his own should be built up slowly.

If you feel you could offer Pascal his version of tranquility, he will certainly flourish and reward you with endless cuddles on the sofa! Pascal is currently in the Worcester area and looking to move as soon as possible.

Good with other dogsCannot live with catsCannot live with childrenNeutered

name: Pluto
description:
Pluto is a 13-month-old male Cross-Breed, currently located in Cyprus. He is a young, medium-sized dog who has made significant progress since being rescued from a high-kill pound.

At the time of his rescue, Pluto was under extreme stress and was so frightened that he would hide from people, refusing to let anyone get close to him. However, since being brought into the shelter, he has started to show his true personality, slowly coming out of his shell with the help of a fellow dog.

Each day, Pluto reveals more of the loving and funny nature he has hidden inside, and it’s clear that he has the potential to become a happy and playful companion.

Although Pluto still requires patience and understanding, he is developing into a dog with a mischievous side, adding a touch of humour to his personality.

Given his background, Pluto would benefit from being rehomed with another resident dog, as he thrives with the support of other dogs to help him continue his social development. He is a young puppy, and with the right guidance and a loving environment, he will flourish.

Pluto would be best suited to a home with children aged 12 or older, as they will need to respect his boundaries while he continues to adjust to family life.

Although Pluto has not been tested with cats, his young age suggests that with careful introductions, he could adapt well to living with them.

Pluto has come so far since his rescue, and he is ready for the next step in his journey – finding a forever home where he can continue to feel safe, loved, and supported.

If you are willing to provide the patience and care Pluto needs to continue blossoming, he could be the perfect addition to your family.

name: Cassie
description:
Cassie is a 1 year old female Cross-Breed. She is currently under the care of rescuers in Cyprus after being saved from a very difficult and abusive situation. Along with her sister, Cassie was confiscated from a home where she had been subjected to cruelty.

The man who owned her was also abusing his children and has since been jailed. When rescued, Cassie had visible scars around her neck from being tied, and was nearly taken to be put to sleep before being saved.

Despite everything she has endured, Cassie remains incredibly friendly and loving, especially with children. Her resilience and gentle spirit shine through, and she is finally safe and being treated with the compassion she deserves.

She is a happy young dog who is now experiencing love and kindness for the first time.

Cassie has only just arrived in care, so she has yet to be introduced to other dogs or cats. However, she has shown herself to be a wonderful companion around respectful children.

She is vaccinated, wormed, and has had all her blood work done. Cassie is now searching for a forever home where she can be treasured and loved for the special girl she is.

name: Bruno
description:
Bruno is a 3-year-old male Cross-Breed. He is a large-sized dog currently in a pound in Cyprus, where he has sadly spent the last two years of his life waiting for a loving home.

Despite his long stay, Bruno remains a cheerful and affectionate dog who is eager to be part of a family.

Bruno gets along well with people, children, and other dogs, and can be rehomed either alone or with a resident female dog. While he has not been officially cat tested, it is noted that he does not like cats.

He is suitable to live with respectful children over 5 years old, making him a great option for a family environment.

This handsome boy is full of life and loves to play. He particularly enjoys water, playing with balls and toys, and going out for walks.

Bruno is an all-around happy dog who is ready to bring joy and companionship to his new home.

Bruno will be microchipped, vaccinated, wormed, and will arrive with his own dog passport.

He also comes with full rescue backup from Saving Souls Animal Rescue to support his rehoming in the UK.

name: Sky
description:
Sky is a four year old female English Setter. Sky was given to the shelter by her hunter who could no longer look after her.

The poor girl arrived very nervous with a lot of insecurities, she has taken the move to the selter quite badly but is slowly allowing people to stroke her.

In time and with a patient adopter, she will improve and let her true wonderful character shine though.

Sadly, shelters are tough for dogs like Sky. Although they improve over time, it’s a slow process compared to being in a home with a family who can guide her through life and show her things don’t have to be so scary.

Sky is currently at the shelter we work closely with in North Spain.Sky’s date of birth is 2nd September 2020.

If you are interested in giving wonderful Sky a home, she is available at Setter Brittany Pointer Rescue. Sky is currently in Spain but she is ready to travel to her forever home in the UK.

name: Artie
description:
Artie is a gentle, one-year-old Shepherd mix from Cyprus who is ready to start a new life after being found abandoned in a municipal pound.

Artie is a true sweetheart who is looking for the opportunity begin again. He’s a young dog, estimated to be no more than one year old, and he has already experienced more hardship than any dog should.

He was found abandoned in a municipal pound before being taken in by one of our shelter partners when space became available. Understandably, he arrived frightened and unsure, with signs that he had not received the kindness or care every dog deserves.

Despite his difficult start, Artie has shown himself to be a calm, gentle and sensitive boy. He is not naturally trusting of new people and tends to hang back when meeting someone for the first time, but his shy nature is never defensive. Instead, he quietly observes, waiting until he feels ready to approach.

He will come to you ever so gently and slowly when he’s ready, you just have to earn it! With time and understanding, he begins to show interest, especially if you happen to have a biscuit in hand. Treats have become an important part of his confidence building journey and are really helping him learn that people can be kind.

Among other dogs, we have noticed that Artie has a naturally soothing presence and has formed some lovely bonds with other dogs in the shelter, particularly those who are nervous or have similar temperaments.

He has been a quiet source of comfort to many of them, offering calm companionship and helping them to feel at ease. For this reason, we believe Artie would thrive in a home with another friendly, well-adjusted dog to show him the ropes and offer reassurance.

He is still learning to trust the world around him and will need an adopter who understands the importance of moving at his pace. Artie would do best in a peaceful, semi rural home with access to a secure garden and without too much hustle and bustle.

A household with older children, ideally aged ten and above, would suit him better at this stage, as younger children may feel overwhelming for him. He has not yet been tested with cats so we have no insight as to how he may react to a resident feline.

Artie is a work in progress, but what he lacks in confidence he makes up for in heart. He is a gentle boy with no malice in him, only the quiet hope that life might finally offer him the love and safety he has missed out on so far.

With time, consistency and lots of patience, we believe Artie will come into his own and become a truly devoted companion.

If you are looking to make a real difference to a dog’s life and believe in the quiet power of kindness and patience, Artie may just be the one.

name: Leonardo
description:
Leonardo is a 21 month old male Segugio Cross and is a beautiful, medium-sized boy weighing 12.7 kg.

He arrived at the pound a few months ago and instantly melted our hearts. He’s one of the sweetest boys we’ve ever met.

A little shy at first, but once he trusts you, he’ll wrap his front leg around you and never want to leave your side.

If you could spend all day cuddling him, he’d be the happiest dog!

Leonardo walks nicely on the lead and would be a wonderful addition to any loving family. However, he does much better with female dogs and isn’t so good around males.

If you think you could offer Leonardo the warm home he so deserves, please send us a message.

Leonardo is currently in Cyprus looking for a home in UK.

He will be neutered, vaccinated, chipped, treated for parasites, have his own pet passport and rescue back up from Saving Souls Animal Rescue.

name: Daniel
description:
Daniel is a 4-month-old male Cross-Breed. This little pup is the full package—playful, confident, and ridiculously cute.

He was rescued in Romania after being abandoned with his mum and sibling, but thankfully he’s now thriving in a loving foster home.

Expected to grow to a small to medium size like his 14kg mum, Daniel is already showing off his bold personality.

He adores people, loves sprinting through long grass like he’s in a shampoo commercial, and can’t get enough of his toys or his sibling’s company.

Daniel is ready to pack his tiny bag and catch a ride to his forever home. He dreams of a place with a secure garden to zoom around in, a stash of toys to destroy (lovingly, of course), and a cozy bed to crash in after a long day of being adorable.

Most importantly, he needs a family who’ll be patient as he adjusts to life outside of rescue.

He’s been microchipped, vaccinated, blood tested, and treated for fleas and worms—so he’s basically got his suitcase packed and passport stamped. All that’s left is you.

name: Slinky
description:
Slinky is a striking 11-month-old German Shepherd with the heart of a survivor and the soul of a loyal companion. Looking for an experienced home or foster-to-adopt.

Currently in foster in Guildford (GU4). She is smart, sensitive, and has come an incredibly long way. Now ready to move forward into a forever home where she can continue to thrive and blossom.

Rescue Story:Slinky was rescued after months of neglect along with two other shepherds. Hungry, scared, and abandoned, she survived by sheer will. She was very cautious but has gradually learned to trust people again thanks to her foster carer.

Detailed Information:Slinky is intelligent and loyal but a little stubborn. She needs an experienced handler to continue her progress. She’s affectionate once she feels safe and enjoys play and walks.

Slinky requires a structured routine with plenty of exercise and mental stimulation. She can live alone or with a confident, active dog of similar size. Not suitable for cats, small animals, or small children.

Ideal Home:An adult-only household experienced with shepherd breeds, with a secure garden and time to dedicate to her training and exercise needs.

Health Information:Slinky is healthy, microchipped, up to date with vaccines, and not yet spayed (Rescue will contribute). All dogs are C.Brucella tested before the trip (owners receive a licensed lab test certificate).

RBU, post-adoption support, and 4 weeks free PetPlan insurance provided upon adoption.

name: Cecelia
description:
Cecelia is an 11-month-old female Cross-Breed. She is currently in Romania, under the care of Meadow of Hope Dog Rescue, and is fully prepped and prepped for a fresh start in the UK—vaccinated, spayed, and treated for fleas and worms.

All she needs now is a loving family to make her part of their world.

Rescued from a travellers site in Romania, Cecelia hasn’t had the easiest start to life. Most of her puppyhood has been spent in private foster care, getting used to shelter life rather than a cosy home.

But despite everything, she’s kept her hopeful little spark alive, and she’s absolutely ready to swap concrete floors for comfy sofas and cold kennels for warm cuddles.

Cecelia is a playful and friendly pup who adores spending time outside her kennel. Give her a bit of open space and a few doggy pals, and she’s in her element—running around, playing, and enjoying life like any young dog should.

She’s especially content when she’s surrounded by people, soaking up every bit of love and attention that comes her way.

Curious and bright, Cecelia has a genuine eagerness to explore the world beyond the shelter gates. With a bit of guidance and patience, she’ll thrive in a home where she’s allowed to learn, grow, and live her best dog life.

name: Joy
description:
Joy is a 5-year-old female Staffordshire Bull Terrier. True to her name, she brings a whole lot of happiness in a small, sturdy package.

Currently waiting to travel to her forever home, Joy is neutered, microchipped, fully vaccinated, and even has her own passport—talk about a well-prepped pup!

This gorgeous Staffie is all about the humans. She absolutely thrives on attention and affection, making her the perfect cuddle buddy for someone looking for a loyal, loving companion.

She doesn’t want to share the spotlight though—Joy is a queen and prefers a home with no other pets, thank you very much. No dogs, no cats—just her, her humans, and a comfy spot on the sofa.

She’s got all her paperwork sorted, including the various blood tests required for travel, and would be delivered straight to your doorstep by a registered pet transport company.

Talk about VIP treatment! Plus, she comes with lifetime rescue back-up, so her new humans can always count on support.

Joy just wants a soft bed, a safe home, and someone to give all her love to. She’s a sweetheart through and through, and would make the perfect companion for someone ready to give her the one-on-one attention she deserves.

name: Scout
description:
Scout, UK Surrender, A Bouncy Boy Saved from Danger, Looking for Safety and Kindness. Located Leicester LE9.

Scout is a cheerful and sweet-natured about 10 months old Labrador cross, still just a big puppy in need of guidance and security. He’s a large-sized boy with an even larger heart.

Rescue Story:A rather strange and sad tale – Scout was reportedly rescued from an act of cruelty. A woman told us she saved him from a man who intended to drown him. But although she saved his life, she couldn’t keep him. Her dog was not accepting him.

She found him a home but after 1 night they said he is too energetic for them and there 3 years old daughter scared of him. She was calling all Rescue places and nobody could help.

She was so desperate and so grateful when our Foster agreed to take him on.He was passed on again, landing in an emergency foster who kindly stepped in. Now Scout needs a stable place where he will be loved.

Detailed Information:Scout is very much a typical young Lab cross – friendly, excitable, loves people, and adores a good game of fetch. His whole body wags when he sees other dogs, and he’s keen to make friends.

He is used to living indoors. On the lead, he’s surprisingly good – pulls but manageable, just enthusiasm for life. He eats dry biscuits but would no doubt enjoy a tastier menu.

Scout does not like being shouted at or overwhelmed – he’s still learning how to be confident and secure, and a calm, consistent routine will help him flourish. At this stage, he’s better suited to a home without very young children, just to ensure he feels relaxed and safe.

We don’t recommend pairing male dogs to prevent potential competition, even if it hasn’t been an issue in the past. Prevention is always better.

Ideal Family:Scout needs a loving, calm household – ideally with access to a secure garden, and people home more often than not. He’d love to play, explore, and learn new things in a safe and positive environment. A dog-savvy family with older children or a kind female dog companion would be ideal.

Scout is young, impressionable, and full of hope. With the right people by his side, he’ll blossom into a loyal, happy companion. He’s not had the easiest start, but he’s been gentle through it all – eager for love, eager to belong.

Could you be the calm voice and steady hand that gives him that second chance?

Health Information:Scout is currently healthy but not yet neutered. He will be neutered once assessed and settled in foster. Vaccination and microchipping will also be arranged.

RBU, post-adoption support, and 4 weeks free PetPlan insurance provided upon adoption.

name: Neo
description:
Neo is a 3-year-old male Cross-Breed. We don’t know what his life was like before, but one thing’s clear: this boy has a heart full of love and a whole lot of life left to give.

Found wandering alone in a remote Croatian village, Neo was abandoned and left to fend for himself. But despite it all, he hasn’t lost his sweetness — in fact, it’s what shines brightest about him.

He’s an incredibly gentle, people-oriented dog who thrives on human connection. Neo craves companionship and bonds deeply with those who give him affection.

While he gets along with female dogs and some males, he’d definitely prefer to be the only dog in the home — not because he’s difficult, but because he’s just built for soaking up all the love on offer.

Neo weighs 28kg and stands at 55cm tall, making him a solid, medium-large boy who’s full of energy and ready for adventure. He’s healthy, eager for his next chapter, and absolutely deserves a safe, stable home where he can finally exhale.

Through Meadow of Hope Dog Rescue, Neo is ready for a forever family that will give him the attention and care he’s been missing.

name: Sam
description:
Sam is a 2 to 3-year-old male Cross-Breed. And honestly? He’s basically a 45kg ball of fluff and love — a total teddy bear with a tail.

Despite a rocky chapter in his life, where he was hit by a car and left unable to move, Sam never stopped wagging his tail.

That’s the kind of soul he is: full of gratitude, resilience, and joy, even in the worst of times.

This gentle giant is curious, kind, and downright irresistible. He’s known for being so sweet that even cats feel totally safe around him — which is saying a lot.

Sam is learning about the world with fresh eyes, always smiling and bringing a dose of happiness wherever he goes. His big heart is matched only by his size, and he’s ready to give it all to a forever family.

Sam is vaccinated, blood tested, neutered, flea and worm treated, and microchipped.

Through Meadow of Hope Dog Rescue, he’s waiting patiently for someone to give him the love and security he’s never truly had — and let’s be honest, this big softie will return it tenfold.

name: Alfie
description:
Alfie is a 3-year-old male Cross-Breed. He’s a quirky little guy with a unique build—short legs paired with a medium-sized body—basically your classic Romanian cross.

His unusual proportions only add to his charm, and if you’re into dogs that stand out in a crowd, Alfie’s your man.

He’s incredibly friendly with women but can be a bit wary around men. Because of that, he’d be best suited to an all-female home or a household with experience in managing cautious behaviour.

He’s not aggressive—just a little choosy about his company, like your dog-shaped introverted best mate.

Alfie is good with other dogs, which makes him a solid candidate for a multi-dog home. He comes fully neutered, vaccinated, and microchipped, so he’s all prepped and polished for his forever family.

He’ll even arrive at your doorstep via registered pet transport, making the adoption process smooth and stress-free.

The rescue also offers full rescue backup (RBU), so you’re not left in the dark once he’s home. Alfie’s ready to swap rescue life for a cosy couch and some quality bonding time.

name: Baks
description:
Baks – A Loyal Soul Needing Calm, Structure, and a Second Chance. Baks is a Ukraine war dog in need of a safe haven. Available under a foster-to-adopt or foster needed.

Baks is a striking, intelligent 2-year-old small-to-medium-sized boy (44 cm / 15 kg), currently based in East Sussex. After nearly 7 months in the UK, it’s become clear that his current home, despite their deep love for him, is not the right environment.

He needs a fresh start with someone calm, patient and experienced—someone who can help him find his place in the world.

Rescue Story:Baks was found tied to the gates of a Ukrainian shelter—abandoned without explanation, confused and heartbroken. Despite this, he greeted rescuers with a wagging tail and hope in his eyes.

His Ukrainian foster remembers him as one of the sweetest, easiest dogs she’s ever had, showing no aggression or issues during his time there.

Detailed Information:In the UK, Baks has formed a deep bond with his family. He loves music, beach strolls, and forest adventures. He is house-trained, non-destructive, crate-trained, and knows an impressive list of commands including: sit, stay, down, heel, place, leave it, middle, find it, and more.

However, Baks does face challenges. He can be reactive to strangers and unknown dogs, particularly on-lead. He’s wary of men (though adores his male caregiver), and can become territorial at home with visitors.

His body language is subtle, making it harder to detect stress before it builds. He has nipped on occasion due to overarousal or feeling unsafe. He also has a prey drive and will chase wildlife.

Despite this, Baks is incredibly affectionate and loyal with those he trusts. He can be left alone for up to 4 hours, walks well on lead or long line, and finds comfort in his crate. He thrives on routine, mental stimulation, and clear guidance.

Ideal Family:Baks needs an adult-only, dog-free home in a quiet, rural area. His person will need to have some experience—or be open to working with a professional trainer using positive reinforcement methods.

A secure garden is essential, and visits to the home should be minimal and managed. He needs someone who can respect his need for space and predictability.

Baks is not an easy project—but he is a deeply rewarding one. In the right hands, this boy will give his full heart. He is clever, sensitive, and full of potential. What he needs now is a calm place to rest, reset, and begin again.

“He’s truly one of a kind,” says his current family. “We believe in him and will do everything we can to support his transition.”

Health Information:Baks is healthy. Neutered. Vaccinated. Microchipped.All dogs are C.Brucella tested before the trip (owners will receive a licensed laboratory test certificate).

RBU, post-adoption support, and 4 weeks free insurance provided upon adoption.

name: Oscar
description:
Oscar – 5 month old male Cross-Breed – is currently in Croatia and looking for his forever home.

Oscar is a young pup, around five months old, who will grow to be a medium-sized dog. His coat is a beautiful mix of brown, black, and white, matching his calm and soft nature perfectly.

When he arrived at the shelter, he was abandoned—alone, scared, and confused. Despite his fear, Oscar showed a quiet trust, as if sensing the shelter was a safe place at last.

His personality is gentle and affectionate, though a bit shy. He doesn’t demand attention or make a fuss but truly treasures every kind look and soft touch he receives. Because of this, Oscar would thrive best in a home that is patient and loving, where people understand he needs time to feel completely secure.

Oscar is good with other dogs. He currently lives with a young female dog and enjoys playing with her happily, though he is still adjusting and learning what a kindness means. Each day, he grows more confident and more sure that people can be caring, not scary.

Importantly, Oscar is healthy and ready for his new life. He has been vaccinated, microchipped, and treated against parasites both inside and out.

Now, Oscar is looking for a true forever home. A place where he will be loved and cared for, not just as a cute puppy, but as a loyal companion for a lifetime.

If you have the space in your heart and home for a shy but loving friend, Oscar could be the perfect match. He’s waiting patiently for his new beginning.

name: Ben
description:
Ben is a 3 year 9 month old male Vizsla. He’s a gorgeous, healthy boy currently waiting patiently in Cyprus, hoping that someone will finally choose him.

Ben’s the kind of dog who gives off big “pick me, love me” energy—he’s friendly, full of life, and just aching for that forever home where he can finally belong.

He can be a bit selective with some male dogs and has been known to act a little bossy, so a home with a balanced female dog or as an only pet might suit him best.

He’s been assessed as suitable for living with respectful children over 12, which suggests he’d thrive in a more mature, dog-savvy household.

Ben has been waiting far too long and it’s high time he got the attention he deserves. He’d do best with an experienced family who understands the Vizsla energy and is ready to guide him with consistency and love.

He’s got all his travel plans sorted—he’ll arrive neutered, flea-treated, wormed, fully vetted, and with his doggy passport in paw. Plus, he comes with full rescue back-up from Saving Souls Animal Rescue.

This boy is ready to trade in his waitlist life for long walks, proper cuddles, and a home that finally gives back the love he’s been craving.

name: Ringo
description:
Ringo is a 6-year-old male Cross-Breed. Weighing around 10kg, this small boy is currently living a bleak life in a cage, stuck in a pound with little to no comfort.

His story is brutal—found as a stray with a microchip, only for his owner to be contacted and respond by saying he didn’t want Ringo and would kill him if he was returned. So now he waits, day after day, with no family and no reason why.

Despite that trauma, Ringo is still holding on. He can be okay with other dogs but has a habit of bothering them, which causes tension in the pound.

Because of that, a home where he’s the only pet is ideal. He deserves to be someone’s one and only after everything he’s been through.

He’s also okay around respectful children, which opens the door to a loving family environment—just one that understands his past and gives him the space and patience to feel safe.

Ringo is neutered, vaccinated, wormed, flea-treated, and will have his blood work completed before travel. He comes with full rescue back-up from Saving Souls Animal Rescue.

He’s not broken—just let down by humans who should’ve protected him. Now, he needs someone to show him that not all people give up.

name: Tank
description:
Tank is a 2-year-old male Cross-Breed. This medium-sized sweetheart has been stuck in a pound in Cyprus for the past 8 months, just waiting for someone to notice him.

And honestly? It’s about time. Tank is a calm, friendly, and all-around happy dog who’s got the kind of warm, gentle nature that makes you instantly feel at ease.

He’s fantastic with other dogs, getting along with all of them, and would be a brilliant companion in a home with canine company. He’s also suitable for living with respectful children, making him a great fit for a loving family environment.

There’s no info on how he is with cats, but given his easy-going vibe, a careful introduction might go smoothly with the right supervision.

Tank’s been patient long enough. He’s kind, balanced, and deserves a forever home where he’s more than just another face behind bars. With proper care, love, and a comfy sofa, Tank will make a loyal and loving family member.

He’ll arrive fully vaccinated, neutered, wormed, flea-treated, and with all his blood work done. His adoption also includes full rescue back-up from Saving Souls Animal Rescue and his own little doggy passport, ready for his trip to the UK and the good life he’s been waiting for.

name: Zorro
description:
Zorro is a 4.5-year-old male German Shepherd Dog Cross. He’s a strong, happy, and active boy who’s currently stuck in a grim, overcrowded Municipality Pound in Cyprus—definitely not the life a dog like him deserves.

He’s friendly and has a bright personality, but due to his breed and size, he’s looking for a family that has experience with German Shepherds and understands the needs of a big, intelligent dog.

Zorro must be the only dog in the household, as he can be selective with others and would thrive best with all the attention to himself. He’s suitable for a home with children over 12 years old—simply because of his size, not because of any behavioural issues.

With the right family, Zorro has the potential to be an incredibly loyal and loving companion.

He will be fully vaccinated, microchipped, treated for parasites, and will come with his own pet passport.

Rescue back-up is provided by Saving Souls Animal Rescue, ensuring that Zorro will have support every step of the way on his journey to his forever home.

All this boy needs is someone willing to give him the second chance he so clearly deserves.

name: Bowie
description:
Bowie is a 3 year 4 month old male Cross-Breed who is medium in size and currently living in Cyprus. He has been at the shelter for a few months and is really not coping well with confinement.

He’s stressed out, constantly crying, and can’t sit still in his cage.

However, once he is outside, he reveals a completely different side of himself: a calm, gentle, and affectionate dog, looking for cuddles and attention.

He enjoys moments of companionship and is eagerly waiting to find someone ready to offer him the love he deserves.Bowie is very social with other dogs and playful. That said, for a harmonious coexistence, it would be preferable if he shares his home with a female dog.

His love for treats will be an asset for his future training, as he is highly motivated by rewards! Bowie is excitedly looking forward to his opportunity for a new start!

Bowie is currently in Cyprus looking for a home in UK. He will be neutered, vaccinated, chipped, treated for parasites, have his own pet passport and rescue back up from Saving Souls Animal Rescue.

name: Dante
description:
Dante is a 3 year 9 month old male Cross-Breed. This gentle soul has had a rough start, arriving at the pound in Cyprus shy and uncertain. At first, he was barely visible—keeping to the back of his kennel, doing his best to disappear.

But it didn’t take long for Dante to realise he was finally safe, and that no one was going to hurt him anymore.

Within just a few days, his true personality started to shine. Dante transformed from a hidden shadow into a cheerful pup, tail wagging and eager to leave his kennel for a stretch.

He became visibly happier and began seeking out human interaction, especially when accompanied by a female dog.

Going on walks with a calm female companion helped him build confidence around people. While he hasn’t yet been tested with male dogs, he has proven to be friendly and relaxed around females.

He’s the kind of boy who thrives on quiet encouragement and gentle patience.

Dante is described as soft and sensitive—exactly the kind of dog who just needs someone to believe in him. He may take a little time to fully open up, but once he does, you’ll have a loyal and affectionate buddy for life.

He’s currently still in Cyprus but is looking for a forever home in the UK.

He’ll come fully prepped for his new life—neutered, vaccinated, microchipped, treated for parasites, and carrying his own pet passport. Plus, he’s backed by the support of Saving Souls Animal Rescue, so you’re not adopting alone—you’ve got backup!

name: Frieda
description:
Frieda is a 4 year 4 month old female German Shepherd Cross, currently in Cyprus and weighing 19kg—your classic medium-sized sweetheart.

She came into the pound looking rough around the edges, carrying the kind of past we can only guess at—probably more heartbreak than happiness. But despite it all, Frieda is bursting with life and excitement, always eager to greet the world.

Her love for walks knows no bounds, and when the volunteers show up, she’s pacing with hope, ready to break free from the kennel and taste the freedom she’s craving.

She’s friendly with people and gets along well with other dogs, showing just how gentle and loving she truly is. But the grind of shelter life is wearing her down, and it’s clear she needs out—ASAP.

Frieda needs a forever home more than ever—a place where she can finally feel safe, loved, and cherished. If you feel you could offer this sweet soul the life she deserves, please message our page.

Frieda is currently in Cyprus looking for a home in the UK. She will be neutered, vaccinated, chipped, treated for parasites, have her own pet passport and rescue back up from Saving Souls Animal Rescue.

name: Roberto
description:
Roberto is a 2 year 3 month old male Hound Cross. This charming, medium-sized lad weighs in at 21 kg and was found wandering in a village near Ayia Napa.

Despite his friendly nature and zest for life, he’s still stuck in the pound, patiently waiting for someone to give him a shot at happiness.

Roberto is full of potential. He’s a sociable, people-loving boy who lights up when he’s around humans. His youth means he’s got loads of energy and curiosity, and he’s more than ready to spend it exploring the world outside those kennel walls.

While Roberto does walk well with female dogs, he can be a little picky when it comes to canine company. Because of this, he’d likely thrive best as the only dog in the household, soaking up all the love and attention for himself.

He walks well on the lead, so whether it’s a brisk morning walk or a casual weekend wander, Roberto’s totally up for it. He’d be a great adventure buddy for someone who’s looking for a loyal companion to keep up with an active lifestyle.

He’ll arrive in the UK fully prepped—vaccinated, neutered, microchipped, treated for worms and fleas, and armed with his very own doggy passport. He also comes with full rescue backup from Saving Souls Animal Rescue, which means you’re never alone on the journey.

name: Kriss
description:
Kriss is a 2 year old male Cross-Breed. His journey hasn’t been an easy one—just a few weeks ago, he was spotted wandering the streets of Dubrovnik, starving, malnourished, and desperately searching for safety and affection.

Thankfully, some concerned locals noticed him and reached out for help, and now Kriss is finally safe in a shelter in Croatia.

Since arriving, Kriss has completely turned things around. He’s shown himself to be an upbeat, curious, and playful pup, full of life and energy.

He’s not just surviving anymore—he’s thriving, and he’s ready to find that special someone who’ll give him the loving home he’s never had.

Kriss gets along well with female dogs and would do great in a home where he can share his joy without stress. He’s the kind of dog who brings a spark into a room—cheerful, eager to play, and easy to love.

If you’re looking for a no-drama, happy-go-lucky companion who’s all about fun and tail wags, Kriss is the guy.

He’s already microchipped, castrated, blood tested, vaccinated, and treated for fleas and worms—fully kitted out and ready to go. Kriss comes with rescue back-up from Meadow of Hope Dog Rescue, and standard adoption checks will apply.

name: Leia
description:
LEIA – A Devoted Soul Ready to Complete Her Journey Home

Leia is a Ukraine war dog in need of a safe haven. Available under a foster-to-adopt. UK Based Retford, DN22 Available For Meet-and-Greet

Leia is a 4-year-old German Shepherd cross, a truly stunning girl with an intelligent mind and an even bigger heart.

She’s already captured the hearts of her foster family – now she’s waiting for her forever one. She arrived in the UK on 20th June, travelling from Ukraine.

SIZE: Upper-medium (55 cm / 30 kg)SPAYED: YesCHARACTER HIGHLIGHTS: Loyal, playful, loving, intelligentDOGS: Selective, best as only dogCATS: Not testedCHILDREN: Great with kids 8+

Foster UpdateLeia settled beautifully into her foster home. She is friendly, affectionate, and adores human company. She’ll lean in for strokes and is happiest close to her people – she’s already proven to be a loyal shadow.

While she has a touch of bounce and energy, it’s been easy to manage with a little guidance.

Leia enjoys spending time outdoors and would love a home with a secure garden and a tall fence where she can safely explore and relax. She travels well in the car, showing calm and relaxed behaviour throughout her journey.

She’s been loving the daily brushing and absolutely thrives on attention – her foster says she’s a joy to have around.

Rescue StoryLeia’s story could have ended in tragedy. She and her companion Dior were found abandoned outside a rural shop, begging strangers for scraps.

The shop owner arranged for them to be poisoned – but one kind worker couldn’t stand by. A rescue team was called and arrived just in time. Now safe and thriving in the UK, Leia is ready to complete her journey home.

More About LeiaLeia is highly intelligent, eager to please, and picks things up quickly. She enjoys walks, enrichment. Selective to other dogs, tolerant or even playful on walks, prefers not to share space and home, perfect as the only dog.

She would suit an active, caring home – one that offers companionship, structure, and security. She’s good with older children (8+) who respect her space and energy.

Health InformationLeia is fully healthy, spayed, and up to date on all core vaccines. She’s microchipped, and all dogs are C.Brucella tested before travel (owners will receive a licensed laboratory test certificate).

RBU, post-adoption support, and 4 weeks free PetPlan insurance provided upon adoption.

name: Nora
description:
Say hello to Nora – 1 year old female Saluki Cross who’s shy, sweet, and quietly adorable. She’ll warm up quickly in a loving home, especially if you’re around a lot to give her those cuddles she craves.

Nora was rescued when she was a newborn pup after her mum had been abandoned to the streets of Muscat. They went into foster until Nora was 3 months old and now she is in a boarding facility.

She has recently spent time in a foster home again which gave us a good insight into her behaviour in a home environment.

Her foster family describes her as shy, sweet, and quiet. She does like some people instantly but will need some time with others to get closer.

With the foster mum being at home a lot, she warmed up fast and started to cuddle and play. She followed her two foster sisters in everything and copied their behavior, but there was some conflict at times over toys and space.

The foster family thinks she’d be better in a home with other dogs as long as they were male or friendly females.

She is very playful, happy, and active, but also sleeps a lot during the day. She likes toys, running around the garden, and her treats.

Potty training went well when she had access to the garden. She listened well to her name, but sits are still a challenge to learn. She likes her walks and is easy on the leash, but new sounds and people still make her nervous. She seems food motivated and is a happy eater.

All in all a really lovely young dog with good potential to be the best family dog. She will benefit from another dog for confidence, but it’s not essential. She is protective of the house and will bark when she is alerted, but not much.

Nora is fully vaccinated, microchipped, and spayed. She will be ready to travel to the UK in September/October 2025.

name: Rosie
description:
Rosie is a 5-6-year-old female German Shorthaired Pointer. Rosie is currently in Cyprus, and she is a stunning girl with an amazing rich brown coat that makes her stand out.

She weighs 18 kilograms, which is a great size for someone looking for a dog that’s neither too big nor too small. Rosie is known for her good nature and her boundless love for humans, cuddles, and affection.

Rosie is an active and happy girl who absolutely adores spending time outdoors. Despite her love of adventure, she equally enjoys chilling on the sofa with her favourite humans, soaking up all the love and snuggles she can get.

When Rosie goes out for her walks, she transforms into an even happier dog, and you can see how content and relaxed she becomes afterwards.

Rosie is a total stunner and has been patiently waiting for someone to notice her and offer her the second chance she truly deserves.

It’s clear that Rosie needs a loving home where she can experience the warmth of a caring family, a soft bed to sleep in, and the security she has been longing for.

When it comes to doggy friends, Rosie loves all male dogs and gets along really well with them. However, she’s not always so keen on female dogs, so it would be best if her future home doesn’t have any female canine companions.

Rosie walks beautifully on the lead, which makes walks with her enjoyable and stress-free for her new family.

Rosie comes with full rescue back-up from Saving Souls, which means her future family will always have support if needed. She will arrive neutered, vaccinated, treated for parasites, and with her own doggy passport, ready for a new adventure in her forever home.

Anyone out there who can offer Rosie the loving home she’s been dreaming of will be rewarded with endless affection, loyalty, and the joy of giving this sweet girl the life she’s always deserved.

name: Jack
description:
Jack is a 4-year 9-month-old male Cross-Breed. Jack is currently in Cyprus, patiently waiting for his chance to find a loving forever home in the UK.

Despite his tough start in life, Jack has proven to be a gentle and calm soul who amazes everyone at the shelter each and every day. He has a super friendly nature with humans, always ready to offer love and affection.

Jack formed a strong bond with the female dogs who came with him from the landfill to the shelter. He’s friendly with all female dogs but is selective with males, which isn’t too surprising given his past.

It’s believed that Jack was the protector of his lady friends while they lived together at the landfill, keeping them safe during their harsh life as strays.

For this reason, Jack would be best suited to a home where there’s a female resident dog he can buddy up with. His gentle movements and calm interactions make him a wonderful companion who would fit beautifully into a peaceful home environment.

Jack loves his walks and is a joy to take out, as he walks well on the lead without pulling or fussing. His time at the shelter has revealed what an incredible dog he truly is, especially considering that he likely spent most of his life surviving on the streets.

Despite his background, Jack is well socialised with people thanks to the workers who spent time building his trust and confidence.

It’s truly impressive how Jack has blossomed into such a good-natured and loving dog. He deserves a second chance in a warm, caring home where he can finally experience the comfort and security he has missed out on for so long.

Jack will come vaccinated, microchipped, treated for parasites, and with his own pet passport, ready to embark on a new adventure in the UK. Plus, he’ll have full rescue back-up from Saving Souls Animal Rescue, ensuring his new family always has support.

Anyone who opens their heart to Jack will gain a devoted friend who has already proven just how much love he has to give.

name: Bruno
description:
Bruno is a 2-year 6-month-old male Cross-Breed. Bruno is currently in Cyprus, waiting patiently for his chance to find a loving forever home where he can finally stretch his legs somewhere other than the shelter yard.

Described as a goofy boy, Bruno is a handsome young dog bursting with personality and charm, who just wants someone to notice his big, hopeful eyes.

It’s heartbreaking to watch Bruno, a happy and playful boy, stuck in the shelter where his only joy comes from short bursts of playtime in the yard with his doggy friends. Seeing him beg with his eyes for just a little extra time outside shows just how much he craves freedom, adventure, and a loving family.

Bruno’s eyes reveal his true soul: a dog desperate to be loved and included as part of someone’s life. He adores humans and wants nothing more than to share his days with people who appreciate his playful, energetic nature.

He also loves water and having fun with other dogs, proving that he’s ready for all kinds of adventures.

As an active dog with a strong, muscular build, Bruno weighs in at a solid 24 kilograms. While he’s all muscle, he’s not a giant in stature, making him a medium-sized dog perfect for those who want a sturdy companion without the overwhelming size of a large breed.

Bruno needs a home with an active lifestyle, where his boundless energy and love for outdoor activities will be embraced. He thrives on play, exercise, and adventures with humans who share his enthusiasm for life and the outdoors.

Despite his current circumstances, Bruno has remained a loving boy who enjoys every moment of human interaction he can get. His loyalty and affection make him a wonderful companion for the right family who can give him the exercise, love, and attention he deserves.

Bruno comes with full rescue back-up from Saving Souls, so his future family can adopt with confidence knowing they’ll always have support. He will also be vaccinated, neutered, treated for parasites, and have his blood work done, ensuring he arrives healthy and ready for a new beginning.

Bruno has so much love and life left to give. All he needs is someone willing to see past the kennel bars and offer him the chance he’s been waiting for.

name: Aris
description:
Aris is a 9-year-old male Cross-Breed. Aris is currently in Cyprus, where he has been waiting patiently for a new home for the past 16 months.

It’s heartbreaking to think about his journey: surrendered by the only family he had ever known after living with them since he was a puppy, Aris went straight from the warmth of a home to the cold reality of a shelter cage.

Despite the upheaval he has faced, Aris remains one of the friendliest dogs you could ever meet when it comes to humans. He adores people and is eager to please, always ready to show off his affectionate and loving side to anyone willing to give him a chance.

His time spent with his previous family wasn’t wasted either; he was well-trained and his obedience still shines through.

Aris obeys commands and walks beautifully on the lead, which makes outings with him easy and enjoyable. He is a big boy at 30 kilograms, but he carries himself with grace and calm, proving that he’s a mature dog who just wants to be someone’s loyal companion again.

While Aris has an incredible temperament with humans, he’s not fond of other dogs or animals, so he needs to be the only pet in his future home. Given what he’s been through, it’s understandable that he prefers having his humans all to himself, where he can soak up every bit of love and attention.

His shelter caretakers believe that somewhere out there is a perfect home for Aris — a place where he can experience the security, comfort, and affection he once knew. After everything he’s been through, he more than deserves a second chance at happiness.

Aris comes with full rescue back-up from Saving Souls, ensuring his new family will always have support. He will also be treated for parasites, vaccinated, and arrive with his own doggy passport, ready to start his new life.

For anyone willing to open their heart to a loyal, affectionate, and well-behaved older dog, Aris is ready and waiting. He just needs someone to finally see him and give him the home he has been dreaming of for so long.

name: Vinnie
description:
Vinnie is reactive to people visiting the home which can cause him to bark and growl at them. Vinnie will need a home with minimal visitors and someone willing to continue building his confidence and provide training.

Vinnie is a very loyal, loving and affectionate dog. He isn’t a fan of baths or showers and hates being wet however he takes this in his stride.

He loves cuddles and getting lots of attention from his favourite people however he equally likes his own space in the home to be able to settle and have some alone time.

He loves being outside in the garden and is a super playful boy who loves his toys, especially anything that squeaks and he will spend hours chewing his bones.

Vinnie accepts a collar, harness and lead. He is very strong on the lead and does pull however he will calm down and responds well to heal.

He can however be reactive towards other dogs on walks which causes him to bark, growl and squeal, this is due to excitement and not aggression.

Once he has said hello to the dog or they have passed he will calm down. Vinnie loves his walks and loves to run around in secure fields and burn off his energy. Vinnie is a high energy boy who needs an active family to give him lots of attention and time.

He will need lots of long walks, training and mental stimulation to keep him out of trouble and keep him busy but more importantly he needs someone who can love him unconditionally.

He has a beautiful personality and character. Vinnie has been known to be noise reactive to noises he hears outside especially people and he will bark if people knock on the door.

He would therefore prefer a home in a quieter area.Vinnie is toilet trained but is not crate trained. He can be known to be destructive towards shoes, carpet and does love to dig holes in the garden.

Vinnie can be left alone for short periods of time within the home with no issues. He sleeps well overnight and travels well in the car.

name: Hera
description:
Hera is nervous around visitors in the home which will cause her to be reactive and bark at them however once trusted she is very loving. She regularly visits her 92 year old owner’s dad who she is very good with.

Hera accepts a collar, harness and lead. She is very strong on the lead and can pull towards things so she will therefore need a strong owner to handle her size and strength.

Hera can be reactive towards vehicles, cars, scooters, bikes and buses which can cause her to chase them. She has also recently started to become reactive towards dogs on walks too however it is felt this may be due to the other smaller dog in the home having reactive which Hera picks up on.

She will need continued training on this.Hera is toilet trained and crate trained. She isn’t destructive but has chewed her own bed previously.

Hera does show guarding and dominance behaviours with the other dogs. She can be left alone for up to 4 hours with no issues and she sleeps well overnight, she will bark if she needs the toilet.

She is okay in the car but can sometimes need some encouragement. She has been sick on one occasion.
